_meta.note: 祕密發現的對話。這個檔案是產生物——請改 secret/ 底下對應故事的檔案，再跑 tools/quest-bundle.py。直接改這裡下次會被蓋掉。

A Croaking Cryptid#003.src: The hell are you? Some random traveler?
A Croaking Cryptid#003.dst: Quem diabos é você? Um viajante à toa?

A Croaking Cryptid#004.src: Well... My job is to shoo folks like you... But I don' get to talk to people often. So let's talk.
A Croaking Cryptid#004.dst: Bom... Meu trampo é espantar gente que nem você... Mas num falo com ninguém. Então vamo conversar.

A Croaking Cryptid#009.src: Practically everyone 'ere knows me... Some've even seen me... I'm locally feared...
A Croaking Cryptid#009.dst: Quase todo mundo aqui me conhece... Uns até me viram... Sou temido na região...

A Croaking Cryptid#010.src: But... It's a livin'! I'm doin' what I'm supposed to, and it's the only purpose I've ever known. Besides alcohol, 'course.
A Croaking Cryptid#010.dst: Mas... É um ganha-pão! Faço o que devo, e é o único propósito que já tive. Fora a bebida, claro.

A Croaking Cryptid#012.src: Well... Yeah. It's jus' - Eugh. Dey haven't CRRRROAK IN' paid me my fair share in ages!
A Croaking Cryptid#012.dst: Bom... Sim. Argh. Faz séculos que ês num me pagam a CRRRROAC-DANADA da minha parte!

A Croaking Cryptid#013.src: Usually when someone comes to da door, it's DEM. But not today. Not for da past month.
A Croaking Cryptid#013.dst: Quando alguém bate na porta, em geral são ÊS. Mas hoje não. Nem no último mês.

A Croaking Cryptid#014.src: Say. Maybe YOU could 'elp. Dey pay me with bottles o' delicious green liquid. Forget da name. I bet you can get it elsewhere, though.
A Croaking Cryptid#014.dst: Ó. Talvez VOCÊ possa ajudar. Ês me pagam com garrafas dum líquido verde delicioso. Esqueci o nome. Mas cê acha em outro lugar.

A Croaking Cryptid#015.src: Dey tend to come from the east side a' the Bog. I think. Maybe if ya looked there, ya'd find the stuff I want.
A Croaking Cryptid#015.dst: Ês costumam vir do lado leste do Brejo. Acho. Se procurar por lá, talvez ache o que eu quero.

A Croaking Cryptid#016.src: In exchange? Err... Tell ya what. I'll let'cha into my place. And we can have a nice conversation about... Er... Whatever you want, I guess.
A Croaking Cryptid#016.dst: Em troca? Hã... Seguinte. Deixo cê entrar na minha casa. E a gente pode ter uma boa conversa sobre... Hã... O que cê quiser, acho.

A Croaking Cryptid#017.src: Sound like a deal? I hope so. Come back when you make some progress.
A Croaking Cryptid#017.dst: Fechado? Espero que sim. Volte quando tiver algum progresso.

A Croaking Cryptid#018.src: Who is paying you? And for w
A Croaking Cryptid#018.dst: Quem te paga? E pelo quê?
A Croaking Cryptid#018.full: Who is paying you? And for what?

A Croaking Cryptid#021.src: Hmm... Different bottle than I'm used to... Are ya sure this is da right stuff?
A Croaking Cryptid#021.dst: Hmm... Garrafa diferente da de sempre... Tem certeza que é a coisa certa?

A Croaking Cryptid#022.src: Well, only one way to find out, I s'pose!
A Croaking Cryptid#022.dst: Bom, só tem um jeito de saber, né!

A Croaking Cryptid#023.src: BLECH! What is this stuff? Lemme read the label...
A Croaking Cryptid#023.dst: ECA! Que troço é esse? Deixa eu ler o rótulo...

A Croaking Cryptid#024.src: "Liquefied Emeralds"... Do you folks DRINK this?

A Croaking Cryptid#025.src: Think ya mus' be confused by what I meant. Look east a' here. That's where dey get the stuff, I think.
A Croaking Cryptid#025.dst: Acho que cê num entendeu o que eu quis dizer. Olha pro leste daqui. É lá que ês pegam a coisa, acho.

A Croaking Cryptid#026.src: "{p} Absinthe"... This ain' the stuff I'm lookin' for. Similar name, though.
A Croaking Cryptid#026.dst: "Absinto de {p}"... Num é o que eu procuro. Nome parecido, mas.

A Croaking Cryptid#027.src: Might suffice. Time ta try it!

A Croaking Cryptid#028.src: BLECH! Nope... It's like if tha stuff I like was made without love and joy. Awful.
A Croaking Cryptid#028.dst: ECA! Não... É como se o que eu gosto fosse feito sem amor nem alegria. Horrível.

A Croaking Cryptid#029.src: Go look east of here. Think that's where dey get da proper stuff. Tha good stuff.
A Croaking Cryptid#029.dst: Vai olhar a leste daqui. Acho que é lá que ês pegam a coisa boa. A boa mesmo.

A Croaking Cryptid#030.src: Well - Actually no. I'm not tellin' you that. Dey told me not to tell people. But...
A Croaking Cryptid#030.dst: Bom - Na real, não. Num vou te contar. Ês me disseram pra num contar. Mas...

A Croaking Cryptid#031.src: If ya can complete our little deal, I'll tell ya whatever ya wanna know.
A Croaking Cryptid#031.dst: Se cumprir nosso tratinho, te conto o que quiser saber.

A Croaking Cryptid#032.src: Remember, dey bring da good stuff in wagons from the east. Ya might be able to track it down by goin' that way.
A Croaking Cryptid#032.dst: Lembra, ês trazem a boa em carroças do leste. Se for por lá, talvez cê ache.

A Croaking Cryptid#035.src: How may I help you on this fine day?
A Croaking Cryptid#035.dst: Como posso ajudar neste belo dia?
A Croaking Cryptid#035.speaker: Fia

A Croaking Cryptid#036.full: That seems quite excessive. I don't think I could afford that.

A Croaking Cryptid#037.src: Consequently, that means my pricing standards are also really high. If you want even a bottle of this stuff, you'll need to give me something like... five hundred Liff Leaves?
A Croaking Cryptid#037.dst: Por isso, meus preços também são muito altos. Se quiser nem que seja uma garrafa, vai ter que me dar algo como... quinhentas folhas de Liff?
A Croaking Cryptid#037.speaker: Fia

A Croaking Cryptid#039.src: Why can't I just pay you wit
A Croaking Cryptid#039.dst: Por que não pago com esmeraldas?
A Croaking Cryptid#039.full: Why can't I just pay you with emeralds?

A Croaking Cryptid#041.src: I'll have to think about it.

A Croaking Cryptid#042.src: Can you remind me of what th
A Croaking Cryptid#042.full: Can you remind me of what the deal was?

A Croaking Cryptid#043.src: Can you remind me what to do
A Croaking Cryptid#043.dst: O que eu faço com esta pá mesmo?
A Croaking Cryptid#043.full: Can you remind me what to do with this shovel?

A Croaking Cryptid#044.src: Got anything else you'd like to talk about?
A Croaking Cryptid#044.dst: Quer falar de mais alguma coisa?
A Croaking Cryptid#044.speaker: Fia

A Croaking Cryptid#046.src: ...Got anything else you'd like to talk about?
A Croaking Cryptid#046.speaker: Fia

A Croaking Cryptid#048.src: Welcome back! Got anything to ask?
A Croaking Cryptid#048.speaker: Fia

A Croaking Cryptid#051.src: Oh? Yep, looks like the stuff, only one way to find out!
A Croaking Cryptid#051.dst: Hã? É, parece a coisa, só tem um jeito de saber!

A Croaking Cryptid#052.src: Yes... Come on in, pal. Let's talk.

A Croaking Cryptid#056.src: Well, get yer questions outta the way, I guess.
A Croaking Cryptid#056.dst: Bom, manda as perguntas logo, acho.
A Croaking Cryptid#056.speaker: Croaquin

A Croaking Cryptid#057.src: Well, where did you come fro
A Croaking Cryptid#057.full: Well, where did you come from?

A Croaking Cryptid#058.src: Or smoke cigars. Or drink.. er.. what's this stuff called? Auburn Absinthe? Yeah.
A Croaking Cryptid#058.dst: Ou fumar charuto. Ou beber.. hã.. como chama isso? Absinto Auburn? É.
A Croaking Cryptid#058.speaker: Croaquin

A Croaking Cryptid#059.src: Not that I crrrroakin' care... Drinks and cigars are enough to keep me happy. Plus the thrill of scarin' off idiot citizens, heh.
A Croaking Cryptid#059.dst: Num que eu ligue a mínima crrrroac-danada... Bebida e charuto me bastam. E a emoção de espantar cidadão idiota, he.
A Croaking Cryptid#059.speaker: Croaquin

A Croaking Cryptid#060.src: Let's jus'... move on from 'at. Got anythin' else to say?
A Croaking Cryptid#060.dst: Vamo só... deixar isso pra lá. Mais alguma coisa?
A Croaking Cryptid#060.speaker: Croaquin

A Croaking Cryptid#062.src: As I said earlier, dey ain't been payin' me lately, so dey can shove it.
A Croaking Cryptid#062.dst: Como eu disse, ês num tão me pagando, então que se danem.
A Croaking Cryptid#062.speaker: Croaquin

A Croaking Cryptid#063.src: Er. Got anythin' else to say?
A Croaking Cryptid#063.speaker: Croaquin

A Croaking Cryptid#065.src: What's 'e do, teach the crrrroakin' alphabet?
A Croaking Cryptid#065.dst: Ele faz o quê, ensina o crrrroac-alfabeto?
A Croaking Cryptid#065.speaker: Croaquin

A Croaking Cryptid#067.src: Pal, were you crrrroakin' high or somethin'?
A Croaking Cryptid#067.dst: Chapa, cê tava crrrroac-chapado ou o quê?
A Croaking Cryptid#067.speaker: Croaquin

A Croaking Cryptid#068.src: Er. Awkward. Got anythin' else to say?
A Croaking Cryptid#068.dst: Hã. Que climão. Mais alguma coisa?
A Croaking Cryptid#068.speaker: Croaquin

A Croaking Cryptid#070.src: Welcome, customer, to the sole brewery of Auburn Absinthe!
A Croaking Cryptid#070.dst: Bem-vindo, cliente, à única destilaria de absinto Auburn!
A Croaking Cryptid#070.speaker: Fia

A Croaking Cryptid#071.src: Why, yes I do! Only the goodest green liquid there is! My very own Auburn Absinthe!
A Croaking Cryptid#071.dst: Ora, claro que sim! O líquido verde mais bonzão que há! Meu próprio absinto Auburn!
A Croaking Cryptid#071.speaker: Fia

A Croaking Cryptid#072.src: Uh. Well. I don't know about good, actually. Most people seem to hate it...
A Croaking Cryptid#072.dst: Hã. Bem. Bom eu não sei, na verdade. Quase todo mundo parece odiar...
A Croaking Cryptid#072.speaker: Fia

A Croaking Cryptid#073.src: There's like, one person who consistently comes around for it. Though they haven't shown up in a while, weirdly.
A Croaking Cryptid#073.dst: Tem tipo uma pessoa que sempre vem buscar. Mas, estranhamente, faz tempo que não aparece.
A Croaking Cryptid#073.speaker: Fia

A Croaking Cryptid#074.src: When they do come by, though, they buy a LOT. They seem to have a lot of valuable resources, so I've gotten quite rich off it!
A Croaking Cryptid#074.dst: Mas quando vem, compra MUITO. Parece ter muitos recursos valiosos, então fiquei bem rica com isso!
A Croaking Cryptid#074.speaker: Fia

A Croaking Cryptid#075.src: A lot of people tell me that... Maybe I should lower the price...
A Croaking Cryptid#075.dst: Muita gente me diz isso... Talvez eu devesse baixar o preço...
A Croaking Cryptid#075.speaker: Fia

A Croaking Cryptid#076.src: Well, not now. Can't change these things on impulse.
A Croaking Cryptid#076.dst: Bem, agora não. Não dá pra mudar isso por impulso.
A Croaking Cryptid#076.speaker: Fia

A Croaking Cryptid#077.src: She suddenly appears to be deep in thought...

A Croaking Cryptid#078.src: Aha! I've thought of a deal we can make over this. Ask me about it if you're interested.
A Croaking Cryptid#078.dst: Ahá! Pensei num trato que podemos fazer. Pergunte se tiver interesse.
A Croaking Cryptid#078.speaker: Fia

A Croaking Cryptid#079.src: Alright. Hope to see you again!
A Croaking Cryptid#079.speaker: Fia

A Croaking Cryptid#080.src: What??? You want to pay in emeralds??? But- but they're worthless?!
A Croaking Cryptid#080.dst: Quê??? Quer pagar com esmeraldas??? Mas- mas elas não valem nada?!
A Croaking Cryptid#080.speaker: Fia

A Croaking Cryptid#081.src: It would take you millions of them to equate to the value of five hundred Liff Leaves!
A Croaking Cryptid#081.dst: Precisaria de milhões delas para igualar quinhentas folhas de Liff!
A Croaking Cryptid#081.speaker: Fia

A Croaking Cryptid#082.src: ...Huh? They're valuable where you come from? Well, I don't know where you're from, but here, they're worth dirt.
A Croaking Cryptid#082.dst: ...Hã? Elas têm valor de onde você vem? Não sei de onde você é, mas aqui valem tanto quanto terra.
A Croaking Cryptid#082.speaker: Fia

A Croaking Cryptid#083.src: Ah. To be honest, I don't have many... Besides... The one...
A Croaking Cryptid#083.dst: Ah. Para ser sincera, não tenho muitas... Além... Daquela...
A Croaking Cryptid#083.speaker: Fia

A Croaking Cryptid#084.src: Uhm. You know the rumors about the Bog Frog?
A Croaking Cryptid#084.dst: Hum. Já ouviu os boatos do Sapo do Brejo?
A Croaking Cryptid#084.speaker: Fia

A Croaking Cryptid#085.src: They say he's a powerful Cursed that takes the form of a Frog. There is much debate as to if he's real or not.
A Croaking Cryptid#085.dst: Dizem que é um poderoso Amaldiçoado em forma de sapo. Muito se discute se ele é real.
A Croaking Cryptid#085.speaker: Fia

A Croaking Cryptid#086.src: But... HE IS!!! ...See, usually I have to venture into the Bog to find the ingredients for Auburn Absinthe.
A Croaking Cryptid#086.dst: Mas... ELE É!!! ...Veja, eu costumo entrar no Brejo para achar os ingredientes do absinto Auburn.
A Croaking Cryptid#086.speaker: Fia

A Croaking Cryptid#087.src: Historically, my family has warned to stay out of the deeper parts of it, because of the rumors... But I, a young and naive child, ignored them...
A Croaking Cryptid#087.dst: Minha família sempre avisou para não ir às partes mais fundas, por causa dos boatos... Mas eu, jovem e ingênua, ignorei...
A Croaking Cryptid#087.speaker: Fia

A Croaking Cryptid#088.src: It is only by the grace of the foxes that I was spared... Do not venture into the deep swamp, alright?
A Croaking Cryptid#088.dst: Só pela graça das raposas fui poupada... Não se aventure no fundo do pântano, certo?
A Croaking Cryptid#088.speaker: Fia

A Croaking Cryptid#090.src: Well, since you can't pay with valuable resources, there is something around here that I could ask of you instead.
A Croaking Cryptid#090.dst: Bem, já que não pode pagar com recursos valiosos, tem algo por aqui que eu poderia pedir em troca.
A Croaking Cryptid#090.speaker: Fia

A Croaking Cryptid#091.src: See, I was out gathering the materials I use for brewing the other day, when I realized my most prized possession had gone missing.
A Croaking Cryptid#091.dst: Veja, outro dia eu estava colhendo os materiais que uso para destilar quando percebi que meu bem mais precioso tinha sumido.
A Croaking Cryptid#091.speaker: Fia

A Croaking Cryptid#092.src: It was an heirloom passed down in my family. I hold onto it for good luck. I searched for it for hours, to no avail.
A Croaking Cryptid#092.dst: Era uma relíquia passada na família. Guardo para dar sorte. Procurei por horas, sem sucesso.
A Croaking Cryptid#092.speaker: Fia

A Croaking Cryptid#093.src: This bog is so big. And muddy. I don't know if I could ever find it. So that's where you come in!
A Croaking Cryptid#093.dst: Este brejo é tão grande. E lamacento. Não sei se um dia acharia. E é aí que você entra!
A Croaking Cryptid#093.speaker: Fia

A Croaking Cryptid#094.src: I think you get the point already. Find my heirloom, and I will give you an Auburn Absinthe.
A Croaking Cryptid#094.dst: Acho que já entendeu. Encontre minha relíquia e eu lhe dou um absinto Auburn.
A Croaking Cryptid#094.speaker: Fia

A Croaking Cryptid#095.src: Oh, you'll be needing this, probably.
A Croaking Cryptid#095.speaker: Fia

A Croaking Cryptid#096.src: Hold the shovel outside this house, and look around for sparkly spots. Dig in those spots with the shovel, and see if you can find my precious possession.
A Croaking Cryptid#096.dst: Segure a pá fora desta casa e procure pontos brilhantes. Cave nesses pontos com a pá e veja se acha meu bem precioso.
A Croaking Cryptid#096.speaker: Fia

A Croaking Cryptid#097.src: Ah, alright. Basically, if you go outside my house while holding that shovel, you'll see a bunch of sparkly spots around the place.
A Croaking Cryptid#097.dst: Ah, certo. Basicamente, se sair da minha casa segurando a pá, vai ver vários pontos brilhantes pela área.
A Croaking Cryptid#097.speaker: Fia

A Croaking Cryptid#098.src: Make sure you're stood directly on top of them! Digging just anywhere won't work, you know!
A Croaking Cryptid#098.dst: Fique bem em cima deles! Cavar em qualquer lugar não adianta, viu!
A Croaking Cryptid#098.speaker: Fia

A Croaking Cryptid#099.src: Right-click while standing directly on top of them to dig, and see what you get! Hopefully, it'll be my heirloom.
A Croaking Cryptid#099.dst: Clique direito bem em cima deles para cavar e veja o que sai! Tomara que seja minha relíquia.
A Croaking Cryptid#099.speaker: Fia

A Croaking Cryptid#100.src: Wow, you forgot already? Well... Alright, I guess.
A Croaking Cryptid#100.dst: Nossa, já esqueceu? Bem... Tudo bem, vai.
A Croaking Cryptid#100.speaker: Fia

A Croaking Cryptid#101.src: I think you remember the point. Find my heirloom, and I will give you an Auburn Absinthe.
A Croaking Cryptid#101.dst: Acho que lembra do essencial. Encontre minha relíquia e eu lhe dou um absinto Auburn.
A Croaking Cryptid#101.speaker: Fia

A Croaking Cryptid#102.src: You dug up a meaningless glass shard. You'd have to be a really strange person to keep that as an heirloom.
A Croaking Cryptid#102.dst: Você desenterrou um caco de vidro sem valor. Só alguém muito estranho guardaria isso como relíquia.

A Croaking Cryptid#103.src: You dug up the remains of an Auburn Absinthe bottle that you guess was disgustedly thrown to the ground. Certainly not an heirloom.
A Croaking Cryptid#103.dst: Você desenterrou os restos de uma garrafa de absinto Auburn, jogada no chão com nojo, imagina. Não é relíquia.

A Croaking Cryptid#104.src: You dug up a small beetle. After placing it carefully back down, you continue your search.
A Croaking Cryptid#104.dst: Você desenterrou um besourinho. Depois de devolvê-lo com cuidado, continua a busca.

A Croaking Cryptid#105.src: You dug up a cool-looking rock. Probably not what you're looking for, but it's neat!
A Croaking Cryptid#105.dst: Você desenterrou uma pedra bonita. Não deve ser o que procura, mas é legal!

A Croaking Cryptid#106.src: You dug up an Auburn Absinthe cap. Just as you're about to throw it away, you notice a string attached to it, making it a necklace. This must be it! Time to bring it back to Fia.
A Croaking Cryptid#106.dst: Você desenterrou uma tampa de absinto Auburn. Quando vai jogá-la fora, nota um cordão preso, formando um colar. Deve ser isto! Hora de levar de volta a Fia.

A Croaking Cryptid#107.src: Looks like there wasn't anything there. Maybe it'd be worth trying to look for things sparkling on the ground?
A Croaking Cryptid#107.dst: Parece que não havia nada ali. Talvez valha procurar coisas brilhando no chão?

A Croaking Cryptid#108.src: Oh! Yes, that's it! The cap of the first ever bottle of Auburn Absinthe...
A Croaking Cryptid#108.dst: Oh! Sim, é isso! A tampa da primeira garrafa de absinto Auburn...
A Croaking Cryptid#108.speaker: Fia

A Croaking Cryptid#109.src: My family's been in this business for {~} years... and yet most customers always just left disgusted.
A Croaking Cryptid#109.dst: Minha família está neste ramo há {~} anos... e a maioria dos clientes sempre saiu com nojo.
A Croaking Cryptid#109.speaker: Fia

A Croaking Cryptid#110.src: Maybe I should try to change the recipe..? Oh, right! The deal.
A Croaking Cryptid#110.dst: Talvez eu devesse mudar a receita..? Ah, é! O trato.
A Croaking Cryptid#110.speaker: Fia

A Croaking Cryptid#111.src: Here's a fresh bottle of Auburn Absinthe! I hope you enjoy it!
A Croaking Cryptid#111.dst: Aqui, uma garrafa fresca de absinto Auburn! Espero que goste!
A Croaking Cryptid#111.speaker: Fia

A Croaking Cryptid#113.src: Ya know... I'm not s'posed to let folks like you in here... Don' tell anyone you met me, capiche?
A Croaking Cryptid#113.dst: Sabe... Num devia deixar gente que nem cê entrar... Num conta pra ninguém que me viu, capiche?
A Croaking Cryptid#113.speaker: Croaquin

A Croaking Cryptid#114.src: And you? {u}, eh? I'd say that's a strange name, but I guess I can't crrrroakin' talk.
A Croaking Cryptid#114.dst: E você? {u}, é? Diria que é um nome esquisito, mas acho que num posso crrrroac-falar.
A Croaking Cryptid#114.speaker: Croaquin

A Croaking Cryptid#115.src: Well that's a rude crrrroakin' question to ask the guy who just let you into 'is home, eh?
A Croaking Cryptid#115.dst: Que pergunta crrrroac-grossa pro cara que acabou de te deixar entrar em casa, hein?
A Croaking Cryptid#115.speaker: Croaquin

A Croaking Cryptid#116.src: But I s'pose I must be some sorta freak, given the way most folks seem to react when they see me.
A Croaking Cryptid#116.dst: Mas acho que devo ser algum tipo de aberração, pelo jeito que o povo reage quando me vê.
A Croaking Cryptid#116.speaker: Croaquin

A Croaking Cryptid#117.src: I'm a frog, I guess? Except I'm much bigger and talk human.
A Croaking Cryptid#117.dst: Sou um sapo, acho? Só que bem maior e falo humano.
A Croaking Cryptid#117.speaker: Croaquin

A Croaking Cryptid#118.src: And to be honest with ya? I have no idea why I'm different to the others. I mean, I dunno if you've noticed, but dey ain't exactly fluent in human. Nor do dey wear clothes.
A Croaking Cryptid#118.dst: E pra ser sincero? Num faço ideia de por que sou diferente dos outros. Num sei se cê notou, mas ês num falam humano muito bem. Nem usam roupa.
A Croaking Cryptid#118.speaker: Croaquin

A Croaking Cryptid#119.src: Fun question! I have no crrrroakin' clue.
A Croaking Cryptid#119.dst: Boa pergunta! Num faço a crrrroac-ideia.
A Croaking Cryptid#119.speaker: Croaquin

A Croaking Cryptid#120.src: I don' remember much from my early life... Hardly even my childhood. Real long time ago, see.
A Croaking Cryptid#120.dst: Num lembro muito do começo da vida... Mal lembro da infância. Faz muito tempo, sabe.
A Croaking Cryptid#120.speaker: Croaquin

A Croaking Cryptid#121.src: I was raised by this... er... weird person. Father? Mother? Couldn' really tell. Dey seemed real proud to be my parent, though.
A Croaking Cryptid#121.dst: Fui criado por essa... hã... pessoa esquisita. Pai? Mãe? Num dava pra saber. Mas parecia bem orgulhosa de ser meu pai.
A Croaking Cryptid#121.speaker: Croaquin

A Croaking Cryptid#122.src: Some other folks around 'em did not seem so pleased, I remember. Maybe dey put me here 'cuz 'ey didn' want me...
A Croaking Cryptid#122.dst: Outras pessoas em volta num pareciam tão contentes, lembro. Vai ver ês me largaram aqui porque num me queriam...
A Croaking Cryptid#122.speaker: Croaquin

A Croaking Cryptid#123.src: Uh, yeah, we all have one, don' we? Y'know? The first person ya see when ya emerge from the tar pits?
A Croaking Cryptid#123.dst: Hã, é, todo mundo tem um, né? Sabe? A primeira pessoa que cê vê quando sai dos poços de piche?
A Croaking Cryptid#123.speaker: Croaquin

A Croaking Cryptid#125.src: Not much, really. I s'pose I just sit around like a lazy crrrroakin' loser and wait for the frogs to tell me a human is in the bog.
A Croaking Cryptid#125.dst: Num muito, na real. Fico sentado que nem um crrrroac-preguiçoso fracassado, esperando os sapos me avisarem de humano no brejo.
A Croaking Cryptid#125.speaker: Croaquin

A Croaking Cryptid#126.src: When that happens, I gotta go outside and scare 'em off. Or well, that's usually how it goes, anyway.
A Croaking Cryptid#126.dst: Quando isso acontece, tenho que sair e espantar. Ou bem, em geral é assim que vai.
A Croaking Cryptid#126.speaker: Croaquin

A Croaking Cryptid#127.src: Ah, well, dey're the ones who make me do this, I guess.
A Croaking Cryptid#127.dst: Ah, bom, são ês que me fazem fazer isso, acho.
A Croaking Cryptid#127.speaker: Croaquin

A Croaking Cryptid#128.src: Every couple weeks, see, some weird person with a funny mask shows up with my payment.
A Croaking Cryptid#128.dst: Toda quinzena aparece uma pessoa esquisita de máscara engraçada com meu pagamento.
A Croaking Cryptid#128.speaker: Croaquin

A Croaking Cryptid#129.src: Dey ask me details about the people I scared off. But er, don' worry, I won't tell 'em 'bout you.
A Croaking Cryptid#129.dst: Ês me perguntam detalhes do povo que espantei. Mas hã, relaxa, num vou falar de você.
A Croaking Cryptid#129.speaker: Croaquin

A House Divided#014.src: Around the hundredth year of the Knowledge Age, the great Sovereign Gitephe was also appointed to the prestigious position of Ranger of the {p}, the first ever Sovereign to do so.
A House Divided#014.dst: Por volta do centésimo ano da Era do Conhecimento, o grande Soberano Gitephe foi nomeado ao prestigioso cargo de Patrulheiro de {p}, o primeiro Soberano a consegui-lo.

A House Divided#015.src: He swiftly and effectively dealt with the crises experienced in that region, continuing House Nasin's legacy of loyalty and efficacy.
A House Divided#015.dst: Ele resolveu com rapidez e eficácia as crises daquela região, continuando o legado de lealdade e eficácia da Casa Nasin.

A House Divided#020.src: Sovereign Gitephe of House Nasin was the first Sovereign appointed to the seat of the {p} in the fifth year of the Knowledge Age, becoming the Marshal of the Provincial Guard and bringing further glory to our House.
A House Divided#020.dst: O Soberano Gitephe da Casa Nasin foi o primeiro Soberano nomeado ao posto de {p} no quinto ano da Era do Conhecimento, tornando-se Marechal da Guarda Provincial e trazendo ainda mais glória à nossa Casa.

A House Divided#021.src: In contrast, the ignoble House Thalas produced the unremarkable Sovereign Xima appointed to the lowly region of the {p}.
A House Divided#021.dst: Já a ignóbil Casa Thalas produziu o medíocre Soberano Xima, nomeado à humilde região de {p}.

A House Divided#022.src: House Nasin has always been drawn to power and truth.
A House Divided#022.dst: A Casa Nasin sempre buscou o poder e a verdade.

A House Divided#023.src: We were founded by Salasah Nasin, and we became one of Her Majesty's earliest allies in those dark days, to join her cause in liberating Fruma from the pits of despair, bringing about the start of the Royal Age and recorded history.
A House Divided#023.dst: Fomos fundados por Salasah Nasin e nos tornamos um dos primeiros aliados de Sua Majestade naqueles dias sombrios, aderindo à causa de libertar Fruma do abismo do desespero, dando início à Era Real e à história escrita.

A House Divided#024.src: The illustrious Sovereign Gitephe finally retired after his storied career in the two hundred fifth year of the Knowledge Age.
A House Divided#024.dst: O ilustre Soberano Gitephe enfim se aposentou após sua célebre carreira no ducentésimo quinto ano da Era do Conhecimento.

A House Divided#025.src: His mantle was passed down to Sovereign Rieke, a highly successful Sovereign in her own right, who herself retired in the seventy-fifth year of the New Age.
A House Divided#025.dst: Seu manto passou à Soberana Rieke, uma Soberana de grande sucesso por mérito próprio, que se aposentou no septuagésimo quinto ano da Nova Era.

A House Divided#026.src: Sovereign Zhiraok has also taken on the monumental task of simultaneously overseeing the Roughworks region as its Sovereign has been negligent.
A House Divided#026.dst: O Soberano Zhiraok assumiu ainda a tarefa monumental de supervisionar também a região de Roughworks, pois o Soberano de lá foi negligente.

A House Divided#027.src: After a brief period of inconvenience to our House, our legacy of glory was renewed through the rise of Sovereign Zhiraok of House Nasin in the ninety-eighth year of the Industrial Age.
A House Divided#027.dst: Após um breve período de contratempos para nossa Casa, nosso legado de glória se renovou com a ascensão do Soberano Zhiraok da Casa Nasin no ano 98 da Era Industrial.

A House Divided#028.src: His career as a Sovereign has been extremely successful, and with his guidance the {p} has flourished.
A House Divided#028.dst: Sua carreira como Soberano tem sido um enorme sucesso, e sob sua orientação {p} floresceu.

A House Divided#029.src: We predict that he will continue to bring House Nasin honour far into the future.
A House Divided#029.dst: Prevemos que ele continuará honrando a Casa Nasin por muito tempo.

A House Divided#113.src: Near it, there's the remains of what was likely its cover. It reads "Diary of Gale Nasin".
A House Divided#113.dst: Perto, há os restos do que devia ser a capa. Diz "Diário de Gale Nasin".

A House Divided#114.src: Hm. I'm not sure where that key goes.
A House Divided#114.dst: Hm. Não sei bem onde essa chave vai.
A House Divided#114.speaker: House Nasin Butler

A People's Sovereign#001.src: This trapdoor is locked. Maybe you can find a key to open it?
A People's Sovereign#001.dst: Este alçapão está trancado. Talvez ache a chave para abri-lo?

A People's Sovereign#003.src: I cannot say that I have seen you around here before...
A People's Sovereign#003.dst: Não posso dizer que já o vi por aqui antes...
A People's Sovereign#003.speaker: Girazh

A People's Sovereign#005.src: But besides that, your colors! Where are they?
A People's Sovereign#005.dst: Mas, fora isso, suas cores! Cadê elas?
A People's Sovereign#005.speaker: Girazh

A People's Sovereign#006.src: Such a monotonous form is too strange a sight in this colorful country!
A People's Sovereign#006.dst: Uma forma tão monótona é estranha demais neste país tão colorido!
A People's Sovereign#006.speaker: Girazh

A People's Sovereign#007.src: Do not worry. I can sell you something beautiful!
A People's Sovereign#007.dst: Não se preocupe. Posso lhe vender algo lindo!
A People's Sovereign#007.speaker: Girazh

A People's Sovereign#008.src: For {~} EB, this dye can be yours! If you want it, of course.
A People's Sovereign#008.dst: Por {~} EB, esta tintura é sua! Se quiser, claro.
A People's Sovereign#008.speaker: Girazh

A People's Sovereign#009.src: You... do not want my dye?
A People's Sovereign#009.speaker: Girazh

A People's Sovereign#010.src: I'm giving it to you for a very good price. {~} EB is practically throwing it away on someone like you, who clearly does not appreciate the beauty of color.
A People's Sovereign#010.dst: Estou dando um ótimo preço. {~} EB é praticamente jogar fora com alguém como você, que claramente não aprecia a beleza da cor.
A People's Sovereign#010.speaker: Girazh

A People's Sovereign#011.src: Fine, no worry. I shall hold it for you, until you decide to return.
A People's Sovereign#011.dst: Tudo bem, sem problema. Vou guardá-la até você decidir voltar.
A People's Sovereign#011.speaker: Girazh

A People's Sovereign#014.src: All that can be fixed, for the low price of {~} EB!
A People's Sovereign#014.dst: Tudo isso tem conserto pelo baixo preço de {~} EB!
A People's Sovereign#014.speaker: Girazh

A People's Sovereign#015.src: If you want it, of course.
A People's Sovereign#015.speaker: Girazh

A People's Sovereign#018.src: Why have you not used your gift?
A People's Sovereign#018.dst: Por que não usou seu presente?
A People's Sovereign#018.speaker: Girazh

A People's Sovereign#019.src: Dye is a high value item around here, someone is sure to want it!
A People's Sovereign#019.dst: Tintura vale muito por aqui, alguém vai querer!
A People's Sovereign#019.speaker: Girazh

A People's Sovereign#020.src: Why not try and look on our upper floors?
A People's Sovereign#020.dst: Que tal procurar nos andares de cima?
A People's Sovereign#020.speaker: Girazh

A People's Sovereign#021.src: You are sure to find a buyer eventually.
A People's Sovereign#021.dst: Com certeza vai achar um comprador.
A People's Sovereign#021.speaker: Girazh

A People's Sovereign#022.src: I have not seen your face before.
A People's Sovereign#022.speaker: Robboss

A People's Sovereign#023.src: Nor your colors, come to think... I've never seen clothes in such a lurid shade of 'used'!
A People's Sovereign#023.dst: Nem suas cores, pensando bem... Nunca vi roupa num tom tão berrante de 'usado'!
A People's Sovereign#023.speaker: Robboss

A People's Sovereign#024.src: No matter, it can be sorted ou—
A People's Sovereign#024.speaker: Robboss

A People's Sovereign#025.src: Not one for beauty then, are you?
A People's Sovereign#025.speaker: Robboss

A People's Sovereign#026.src: Come back to me once you've changed your appetite...
A People's Sovereign#026.speaker: Robboss

A People's Sovereign#027.src: You! May I take a look at something that I hear you've received?
A People's Sovereign#027.dst: Você! Posso ver uma coisa que ouvi dizer que você recebeu?
A People's Sovereign#027.speaker: Nawild

A People's Sovereign#029.src: I am in need of some dye ingredients, you see.
A People's Sovereign#029.dst: Preciso de ingredientes de tintura, sabe.
A People's Sovereign#029.speaker: Nawild

A People's Sovereign#030.src: I will gladly speak to you again once you have them!
A People's Sovereign#030.dst: Falo com você de novo com prazer quando os tiver!
A People's Sovereign#030.speaker: Nawild

A People's Sovereign#033.src: Purple dye residue? I'm not too sure what you think you can do with that.
A People's Sovereign#033.dst: Resíduo de tintura roxa? Não sei bem o que acha que pode fazer com isso.
A People's Sovereign#033.speaker: Bassow

A People's Sovereign#034.src: I'm sure that whomever you bought it from is glad to have it out of their hands, though...
A People's Sovereign#034.dst: Mas quem vendeu deve estar feliz de se livrar disso...
A People's Sovereign#034.speaker: Bassow

A People's Sovereign#035.src: How about I give you this to solve your dye problem.
A People's Sovereign#035.dst: Que tal eu lhe dar isto pra resolver sua tintura.
A People's Sovereign#035.speaker: Bassow

A People's Sovereign#036.src: Enjoy, stranger. Someone around these grounds will trade for these readily.
A People's Sovereign#036.dst: Aproveite, forasteiro. Alguém por aqui troca isso de bom grado.
A People's Sovereign#036.speaker: Bassow

A People's Sovereign#038.src: I've already given you my present, dull one!
A People's Sovereign#038.dst: Já lhe dei meu presente, sem-graça!
A People's Sovereign#038.speaker: Bassow

A People's Sovereign#039.src: If you want more presents, speak to someone else.
A People's Sovereign#039.dst: Se quer mais presentes, fale com outra pessoa.
A People's Sovereign#039.speaker: Bassow

A People's Sovereign#041.src: But, I don't believe I've seen you here before...
A People's Sovereign#041.dst: Mas acho que nunca o vi aqui antes...
A People's Sovereign#041.speaker: Nawild

A People's Sovereign#042.src: And therefore, you have no use for these dye ingredients that you've been given, correct?
A People's Sovereign#042.dst: E, portanto, não tem uso para os ingredientes de tintura que lhe deram, certo?
A People's Sovereign#042.speaker: Nawild

A People's Sovereign#043.src: No matter! I have something to give you that will equal their value tenfold!
A People's Sovereign#043.dst: Não importa! Tenho algo para lhe dar que vale dez vezes mais!
A People's Sovereign#043.speaker: Nawild

A People's Sovereign#047.src: If, however, you find yourself not in need of a peacock feather, there will certainly be someone around here who may heavily reward you for this deal in their own right!
A People's Sovereign#047.dst: Mas se não precisar de uma pena de pavão, com certeza há alguém por aqui que vai recompensá-lo muito bem por esta troca, do jeito dele!
A People's Sovereign#047.speaker: Nawild

A People's Sovereign#050.src: I'm sorry stranger, but I have nothing more to give you.
A People's Sovereign#050.dst: Desculpe, forasteiro, não tenho mais nada a lhe dar.
A People's Sovereign#050.speaker: Nawild

A People's Sovereign#051.src: I'll let you know if that ever changes!
A People's Sovereign#051.speaker: Nawild

A People's Sovereign#052.src: No, I take that all back!
A People's Sovereign#052.speaker: Robboss

A People's Sovereign#056.src: Oh! One more thing, while you're here.
A People's Sovereign#056.dst: Oh! Mais uma coisa, já que está aqui.
A People's Sovereign#056.speaker: Robboss

A People's Sovereign#057.src: Let me give you this old key. I'm not too sure where it comes from or how to use it, but surely a traveller like yourself will know what to do!
A People's Sovereign#057.dst: Deixe-me lhe dar esta chave velha. Não sei bem de onde vem nem como usar, mas um viajante como você deve saber o que fazer!
A People's Sovereign#057.speaker: Robboss

A People's Sovereign#058.src: It might even be useful in this very market!
A People's Sovereign#058.speaker: Robboss

A People's Sovereign#059.src: That is all I have for you! Thank you for your business.
A People's Sovereign#059.dst: É tudo o que tenho para você! Obrigado pela compra.
A People's Sovereign#059.speaker: Robboss

A People's Sovereign#060.src: I doubt that you have anything more of interest to me, {u}.
A People's Sovereign#060.dst: Duvido que tenha mais algo do meu interesse, {u}.
A People's Sovereign#060.speaker: Robboss

A People's Sovereign#061.src: Not unless you have another feather, that is.
A People's Sovereign#061.dst: A não ser que tenha outra pena.
A People's Sovereign#061.speaker: Robboss

A People's Sovereign#065.src: Implementation cost to be confirmed - Please consult Sovereign Rieke.
A People's Sovereign#065.dst: Custo de implantação a confirmar - Consulte a Soberana Rieke.

A People's Sovereign#068.src: Reason for denial: Suggestion would be unpopular with public.
A People's Sovereign#068.dst: Motivo da recusa: a sugestão seria impopular com o público.

A People's Sovereign#069.src: Reason for denial: Suggestion unpopular with Sovereign Rieke.
A People's Sovereign#069.dst: Motivo da recusa: sugestão impopular com a Soberana Rieke.

A Wynnic Excavation#001.src: 'Ey, boss, ya sure this is where we need t'blow things up? There's equipment an' all here. This place been empty for a while now too.
A Wynnic Excavation#001.dst: Ô, chefe, cê tem certeza que é aqui que temos que explodir? Tem equipamento e tudo. E o lugar tá vazio faz tempo também.
A Wynnic Excavation#001.speaker: Miner

A Wynnic Excavation#002.src: The small spec I found might not've been much, but it could mean that there are more emeralds nearby. That's why I brought our friend here to confirm.
A Wynnic Excavation#002.dst: O cisco que achei pode não ser muito, mas pode indicar mais esmeraldas por perto. Por isso trouxe nosso amigo aqui pra confirmar.
A Wynnic Excavation#002.speaker: Miner Chief

A Wynnic Excavation#003.src: Hm. Do you hear that? The sound indicates a large body of crystals just right behind these rocks.
A Wynnic Excavation#003.dst: Hm. Ouvem isso? O som indica uma grande massa de cristais logo atrás destas rochas.
A Wynnic Excavation#003.speaker: Geologist

A Wynnic Excavation#006.src: Let's see 'ere... Red, purple, green n' yellow. Say, boss, ain't these them crystal that lad not too long ago asked ya 'bout?
A Wynnic Excavation#006.dst: Vamo ver... Vermelho, roxo, verde e amarelo. Ô, chefe, num são esses os cristais que um rapaz te perguntou faz pouco?
A Wynnic Excavation#006.speaker: Miner

A Wynnic Excavation#007.src: These are not just some 'crystals'. They're... Dangerous. All of you, listen up - never speak a word of what you saw here.
A Wynnic Excavation#007.dst: Não são só uns 'cristais'. São... Perigosos. Todos vocês, ouçam - nem uma palavra sobre o que viram aqui.
A Wynnic Excavation#007.speaker: Miner Chief

A Wynnic Excavation#008.src: Both of you, back to your posts, now! I'll make sure these are never seen again.
A Wynnic Excavation#008.dst: Vocês dois, de volta aos postos, já! Vou garantir que ninguém veja isto de novo.
A Wynnic Excavation#008.speaker: Miner Chief

A Wynnic Excavation#009.src: Inspecting the strange crystal sparks a memory.
A Wynnic Excavation#009.dst: Examinar o estranho cristal desperta uma lembrança.

Aldwell Library#002.src: No medallion! What are you then, a changeling?
Aldwell Library#002.dst: Sem medalhão! É o quê, então, um metamorfo?
Aldwell Library#002.speaker: Aldwell

Aldwell Library#003.src: Can't say I've ever heard of a '{u}' before.
Aldwell Library#003.speaker: Aldwell

Aldwell Library#004.src: Come back when you've got some proof of who you are, '{u}'.
Aldwell Library#004.dst: Volte quando tiver prova de quem é, '{u}'.
Aldwell Library#004.speaker: Aldwell

Aldwell Library#006.src: I thought I told you, you can't fool me!
Aldwell Library#006.dst: Já disse, você não me engana!
Aldwell Library#006.speaker: Aldwell

Aldwell Library#007.src: Oh, you just want to know what's behind this door?
Aldwell Library#007.dst: Ah, só quer saber o que há atrás da porta?
Aldwell Library#007.speaker: Aldwell

Aldwell Library#008.src: Fine. No harm in that, I suppose.
Aldwell Library#008.dst: Tá bom. Não faz mal, acho.
Aldwell Library#008.speaker: Aldwell

Aldwell Library#009.src: I'm in charge of guarding the new {p} Library!
Aldwell Library#009.dst: Eu guardo a nova Biblioteca de {p}!
Aldwell Library#009.speaker: Aldwell

Aldwell Library#010.src: It's a collection of every ancient text found around Mistwood that's been put to paper.
Aldwell Library#010.dst: É uma coleção de todos os textos antigos achados em Mistwood passados ao papel.
Aldwell Library#010.speaker: Aldwell

Aldwell Library#012.src: You won't get past me, {u}. I know what you really are!
Aldwell Library#012.dst: Não vai passar, {u}. Sei o que você é!
Aldwell Library#012.speaker: Aldwell

Aldwell Library#013.src: If you really want me to believe your story, I suppose there's something you could do for me...
Aldwell Library#013.dst: Se quer mesmo que eu acredite em você, acho que há algo que pode fazer por mim...
Aldwell Library#013.speaker: Aldwell

Aldwell Library#014.src: Would you like to hear it?
Aldwell Library#014.speaker: Aldwell

Aldwell Library#018.src: Around {p}, there are four trees that have served as essential parts of our area's history.
Aldwell Library#018.dst: Em volta de {p}, há quatro árvores que foram essenciais na história da nossa região.
Aldwell Library#018.speaker: Aldwell

Aldwell Library#019.src: Flowers grow at their bases too, and they're used in everything from decorating our homes to making helpful remedies.
Aldwell Library#019.dst: Também nascem flores ao pé delas, usadas pra tudo, de enfeitar nossas casas a fazer remédios úteis.
Aldwell Library#019.speaker: Aldwell

Aldwell Library#020.src: My personal supply is running low right now, so I'm in need of a new bouquet...
Aldwell Library#020.dst: Meu estoque pessoal está acabando, então preciso de um novo buquê...
Aldwell Library#020.speaker: Aldwell

Aldwell Library#021.src: My task for you is to go and bring me one of each flower!
Aldwell Library#021.dst: Sua tarefa é me trazer uma flor de cada!
Aldwell Library#021.speaker: Aldwell

Aldwell Library#022.src: The first flower can be found under the white tree of altruism, straight east of here.
Aldwell Library#022.dst: A primeira flor fica sob a branca Árvore do Altruísmo, bem a leste daqui.
Aldwell Library#022.speaker: Aldwell

Aldwell Library#023.src: The second flower blooms inside the tree of community, which is growing all around us!
Aldwell Library#023.dst: A segunda flor brota dentro da Árvore da Comunidade, que cresce ao nosso redor!
Aldwell Library#023.speaker: Aldwell

Aldwell Library#024.src: The third flower grows by the carcass of the tree of renewal, which lies to the south of this library.
Aldwell Library#024.dst: A terceira flor nasce junto à carcaça da Árvore da Renovação, que fica ao sul desta biblioteca.
Aldwell Library#024.speaker: Aldwell

Aldwell Library#025.src: The final flower can be found at the base of the tree of resistance, which the Canopy call their home.
Aldwell Library#025.dst: A última flor fica ao pé da Árvore da Resistência, que o Dossel chama de lar.
Aldwell Library#025.speaker: Aldwell

Aldwell Library#026.src: Come back to me with all four of them, and perhaps we could work something out from there.
Aldwell Library#026.dst: Volte com as quatro, e talvez a gente chegue a um acordo.
Aldwell Library#026.speaker: Aldwell

Aldwell Library#027.src: Have you got me what I asked for yet?
Aldwell Library#027.speaker: Aldwell

Aldwell Library#028.src: No? Well, come back when you do.
Aldwell Library#028.speaker: Aldwell

Aldwell Library#029.src: If you need a reminder, the first flower can be found under the white tree of altruism, straight east of here.
Aldwell Library#029.dst: Para lembrar, a primeira flor fica sob a branca Árvore do Altruísmo, bem a leste daqui.
Aldwell Library#029.speaker: Aldwell

Aldwell Library#030.src: The second flower blooms inside the tree of community, which grows all around us!
Aldwell Library#030.dst: A segunda flor brota dentro da Árvore da Comunidade, que cresce ao nosso redor!
Aldwell Library#030.speaker: Aldwell

Aldwell Library#031.src: The third flower grows in the carcass of the tree of renewal, which lies to the south of this library.
Aldwell Library#031.dst: A terceira flor nasce na carcaça da Árvore da Renovação, que fica ao sul desta biblioteca.
Aldwell Library#031.speaker: Aldwell

Aldwell Library#033.src: I hope that you find them all for the next time we speak.
Aldwell Library#033.dst: Espero que ache todas até a próxima conversa.
Aldwell Library#033.speaker: Aldwell

Aldwell Library#035.src: I'm sure I'll find a use for them soon.
Aldwell Library#035.dst: Logo acho um uso pra elas.
Aldwell Library#035.speaker: Aldwell

Aldwell Library#036.src: In the meantime, enjoy access to the {p} Library!
Aldwell Library#036.dst: Enquanto isso, aproveite a Biblioteca de {p}!
Aldwell Library#036.speaker: Aldwell

Aldwell Library#038.src: I don't care what you are any more, just go through to the library...
Aldwell Library#038.dst: Não ligo mais pro que você é, só entre na biblioteca...
Aldwell Library#038.speaker: Aldwell

Aldwell Library#040.src: It seems to be a book about the different clans in the region, though a little dated- it says it was written in {~} NA. Still, could be fun to flick through.
Aldwell Library#040.dst: Parece um livro sobre os clãs da região, um pouco antigo: diz que foi escrito em {~} NA. Ainda assim, pode ser divertido folhear.

Aldwell Library#041.src: ...That's the end of that passage. Read another?

Aldwell Library#042.src: The Canopy is a merger of three independent clans, the Owls, Foxes, and Deers, who were among the oldest clans in the forest, and had a longstanding rivalry.
Aldwell Library#042.dst: O Dossel é a fusão de três clãs independentes, as Corujas, as Raposas e os Cervos, que estavam entre os clãs mais antigos da mata e tinham longa rivalidade.

Aldwell Library#043.src: Prior to the Cutoff, the Owls were led by Sovereign Caetal, who ruled over the entire {p}, though the Foxes and Deers also vied for the position.
Aldwell Library#043.dst: Antes do Isolamento, as Corujas eram lideradas pelo Soberano Caetal, que governava todo {p}, embora Raposas e Cervos também disputassem o posto.

Aldwell Library#044.src: Each of the three clans had its own strength. The Foxes were adept combatants. The Deers, strategic geniuses. And the owls, stealth.
Aldwell Library#044.dst: Cada um dos três clãs tinha sua força. As Raposas eram boas lutadoras. Os Cervos, gênios da estratégia. E as Corujas, a furtividade.

Aldwell Library#045.src: ...Despite this, Caetal was a man of the people. His blessing of voice helped him rally the community together. The three clans became close, and what had once been a bitter rivalry became a friendly one.
Aldwell Library#045.dst: ...Ainda assim, Caetal era um homem do povo. Sua bênção da voz o ajudou a unir a comunidade. Os três clãs se aproximaram, e o que fora uma rivalidade amarga virou uma amistosa.

Aldwell Library#047.src: After the discovery of the first Changeling, and its subsequent execution, Caetal was removed from his post, and the {p}, cut off from the outside world. Caetal would then disappear.
Aldwell Library#047.dst: Após a descoberta do primeiro metamorfo e sua posterior execução, Caetal foi destituído e {p}, isolado do mundo exterior. Depois, Caetal desapareceria.

Aldwell Library#048.src: The three clans were mortified to have lost the man who brought them so close together, and combined into one group, The Canopy.
Aldwell Library#048.dst: Os três clãs ficaram arrasados ao perder o homem que tanto os uniu e se fundiram num só grupo, o Dossel.

Aldwell Library#049.src: The Canopy has, ever since, been a proactive enemy of the Queen, and their masks have become symbols of resistance against the Changeling threat.
Aldwell Library#049.dst: Desde então, o Dossel é um inimigo ativo da Rainha, e suas máscaras viraram símbolos de resistência contra a ameaça dos metamorfos.

Aldwell Library#050.src: The Kalkalrah Clan is a clan that lives in the further reaches of the {p}, composed of mercenaries-for-hire. They keep no alliances, as they only help whoever pays them.
Aldwell Library#050.dst: O clã Kalkalrah vive nos confins de {p} e é formado por mercenários de aluguel. Não mantêm alianças, pois só ajudam quem paga.

Aldwell Library#051.src: When paid, however, they make up for it well, being some of the most skilled fighters in the region. Generally, they are hired for the task of helping guard.
Aldwell Library#051.dst: Quando pagos, porém, compensam bem, sendo alguns dos lutadores mais hábeis da região. Em geral, são contratados para ajudar na guarda.

Aldwell Library#052.src: The only exception they make is that they refuse to assist in anti-crown activities, as they wish not to become a target for the Queen's military.
Aldwell Library#052.dst: A única exceção é que se recusam a ajudar em atividades contra a Coroa, pois não querem virar alvo do exército da Rainha.

Aldwell Library#053.src: The Peacekeeper's Clan are a group that lives in {p} directly, comprised of those who wish to keep the town a neutral and safe hub for all clans to come together, and a quiet place for citizens to live.
Aldwell Library#053.dst: O clã dos Pacificadores vive diretamente em {p}, formado por quem deseja manter a vila um ponto de encontro neutro e seguro para todos os clãs e um lugar tranquilo para os cidadãos.

Aldwell Library#054.src: Members are usually local volunteers who align with the clan's overarching goal, and want to lend a hand. It has a democratic structure, with leaders chosen by the clan itself.
Aldwell Library#054.dst: Os membros costumam ser voluntários locais que compartilham o objetivo geral do clã e querem ajudar. Tem estrutura democrática, com líderes escolhidos pelo próprio clã.

Aldwell Library#055.src: The Peacekeepers maintain a doctrine of neutrality with other clans, as they do not want to be seen as an enemy to any other clan in the woods. This has earned them high favour with practically everyone.
Aldwell Library#055.dst: Os Pacificadores mantêm uma doutrina de neutralidade com os outros clãs, pois não querem ser vistos como inimigos de nenhum clã da mata. Isso lhes rendeu a estima de praticamente todos.

Aldwell Library#056.src: The Lostheth Clan are a clan of beast-tamers, residing in the outskirts of {p}.
Aldwell Library#056.dst: O clã Lostheth é um clã de domadores de feras que vive nos arredores de {p}.

Aldwell Library#057.src: Up until recent times, the Lostheth clan were a very obscure group, and they were on the verge of disbandment due to lack of interest.
Aldwell Library#057.dst: Até pouco tempo, o clã Lostheth era um grupo bem obscuro, à beira da dissolução por falta de interesse.

Aldwell Library#058.src: However, with the appearance of Adasaurs around the {p}, this all changed. The Lostheth Clan, masters of beast-taming, were quickly able to bring the creatures under their control.
Aldwell Library#058.dst: Porém, com o surgimento dos Adassauros em {p}, tudo mudou. O clã Lostheth, mestre na doma de feras, logo conseguiu pôr as criaturas sob seu controle.

Aldwell Library#059.src: In doing so, they pioneered the practice of riding on their backs. This quickly became a subject of interest to other clans, as well as many citizens, and the Lostheth clan went from being nobodies to one of the best-known clans in the woods.
Aldwell Library#059.dst: Com isso, foram pioneiros na prática de montar nelas. Isso logo despertou o interesse de outros clãs e de muitos cidadãos, e o clã Lostheth passou de ninguém a um dos clãs mais conhecidos da mata.

Aldwell Library#060.src: This book is called "The Four Virtuous Trees"
Aldwell Library#060.dst: Este livro é "As quatro árvores virtuosas"

Aldwell Library#061.src: It's some kind of guide both to survival and morals. Give it a read?
Aldwell Library#061.dst: É uma espécie de guia de sobrevivência e de moral. Ler?

Aldwell Library#062.src: This book is called "The World Outside The Woods".
Aldwell Library#062.dst: Este livro é "O mundo além da mata".

Aldwell Library#063.src: It seems to be a book from {~} KA, talking about other regions. Would you like to read it?
Aldwell Library#063.dst: Parece um livro de {~} KA, falando de outras regiões. Quer ler?

Aldwell Library#064.src: ...That's the end of the introduction. Read another part of the book?
Aldwell Library#064.dst: ...Fim da introdução. Ler outra parte do livro?

Aldwell Library#065.src: There are also various illustrations and maps of the {p}, but it looks almost identical to the {p} of today. Read more of the book?
Aldwell Library#065.dst: Também há ilustrações e mapas de {p}, mas parece quase idêntico ao {p} de hoje. Ler mais do livro?

Aldwell Library#066.src: Next to this description, there is a collection of illustrations of the region. It's completely unrecognizable to you. Read more of the book?
Aldwell Library#066.dst: Ao lado desta descrição, há ilustrações da região. Ela é totalmente irreconhecível para você. Ler mais do livro?

Aldwell Library#067.src: Accompanying the text are sketches of these "great mines," but, as stated by the text, it looked pretty much the same as the regions around it. Read more of the book?
Aldwell Library#067.dst: O texto vem com esboços dessas "grandes minas", mas, como diz o texto, pareciam bem iguais às regiões em volta. Ler mais do livro?

Aldwell Library#068.src: There are drawings of the {p} alongside the text. It looks pretty much the same as you saw it on the way to the tournament, though there may be slight differences. Read more of the book?
Aldwell Library#068.dst: Há desenhos de {p} junto ao texto. Parece bem igual ao que você viu a caminho do torneio, talvez com leves diferenças. Ler mais do livro?

Aldwell Library#069.src: With the text, there are pictures of Aelumia. Though you didn't get to see too much of the city during the tournament, it looks somewhat different to what you remember. Read more of the book?
Aldwell Library#069.dst: Junto ao texto há imagens de Aelumia. Embora você não tenha visto muito da cidade no torneio, ela parece um tanto diferente do que lembra. Ler mais do livro?

Aldwell Library#070.src: It has been {~} years since our freedom to leave these woods was taken from us, and already, many of our youngest are wondering what the lands beyond are like.
Aldwell Library#070.dst: Faz {~} anos que nos tiraram a liberdade de sair destas matas, e muitos dos nossos jovens já se perguntam como são as terras além.

Aldwell Library#071.src: We elders have been a capable source of information on this matter, but the world is changing. We are dying out. And so, I have decided to write down what I know, so it may be passed down for future generations to learn from.
Aldwell Library#071.dst: Nós, anciões, temos sido uma boa fonte de informação sobre isso, mas o mundo está mudando. Estamos morrendo. Por isso decidi escrever o que sei, para que seja passado às gerações futuras.

Aldwell Library#072.src: In the northwest lies the {p}, a vast woodland filled with trees whose leaves take on a warmer colour than the green leaves found on the few deciduous trees in the {p}.
Aldwell Library#072.dst: A noroeste fica {p}, uma vasta floresta de árvores cujas folhas têm cor mais quente que as folhas verdes das poucas árvores caducifólias de {p}.

Aldwell Library#073.src: A river runs through the region, though its water is limited by a colossal dam in the east.
Aldwell Library#073.dst: Um rio atravessa a região, mas sua água é limitada por uma represa colossal a leste.

Aldwell Library#074.src: Tradition has it that, once upon a time, the forest's leaves were green, much like ours, but the reduced flow of water has caused them to lose colour and die, giving them their redder hues.
Aldwell Library#074.dst: Diz a tradição que, outrora, as folhas da floresta eram verdes como as nossas, mas a vazão menor de água as fez perder a cor e morrer, dando-lhes seus tons avermelhados.

Aldwell Library#075.src: There are also legends of a tree bigger than any of ours, from before the Cursed Age. Its stump remains now, the only proof of its existence.
Aldwell Library#075.dst: Também há lendas de uma árvore maior que todas as nossas, de antes da Era Maldita. Hoje resta seu toco, a única prova de sua existência.

Aldwell Library#076.src: The {p} is home to many such traditions, as its people are the most spiritual of any region. The ruins of an ancient temple sit in the northern reaches of the area, holding much value to its god-fearing folk.
Aldwell Library#076.dst: {p} abriga muitas dessas tradições, pois seu povo é o mais espiritual de todas as regiões. As ruínas de um templo antigo ficam no norte da área, de grande valor para seu povo devoto.

Aldwell Library#077.src: This temple is likewise believed to predate the Cursed Age, though its purpose is unknown, so the citizens ascribe various traditions to it. The Crown condemns many of these traditions as heretic in nature, though they persist regardless.
Aldwell Library#077.dst: Também se crê que este templo é anterior à Era Maldita, mas seu propósito é desconhecido, então os cidadãos lhe atribuem várias tradições. A Coroa condena muitas como heréticas, mas elas persistem mesmo assim.

Aldwell Library#078.src: The biggest town in the {p} is {p}, which sits on the boundary with the Agricultural District and is where most traded goods from said region arrive. A large fox statue sits in the town square, serving as a distinct local landmark.
Aldwell Library#078.dst: A maior cidade de {p} é {p}, na divisa com o Distrito Agrícola, aonde chega a maior parte dos produtos dessa região. Uma grande estátua de raposa fica na praça, um marco local inconfundível.

Aldwell Library#079.src: Just to the west of the {p}, still visible from the highest trees at the border, is the Agricultural District.
Aldwell Library#079.dst: Logo a oeste de {p}, ainda visível das árvores mais altas da divisa, fica o Distrito Agrícola.

Aldwell Library#080.src: This name was given to it by the Crown to distinguish it as a region dedicated to agriculture on the behalf of the rest of the province, though some within refer to it by the less stiff, older name "Tolas."
Aldwell Library#080.dst: A Coroa lhe deu esse nome para marcá-lo como região dedicada à agricultura em prol do resto da província, mas alguns lá dentro o chamam pelo nome antigo e menos rígido, "Tolas".

Aldwell Library#081.src: As previously stated, this region is a designated farm zone, where all citizens labour to produce food for the other regions.
Aldwell Library#081.dst: Como já dito, esta região é uma zona agrícola designada, onde todos trabalham para produzir comida para as outras regiões.

Aldwell Library#082.src: Since we were severed from the rest of Fruma, we have stopped receiving the fruits of this labour, though sometimes anti-government clans manage to steal such products from the many Crown supply wagons that pass through the area.
Aldwell Library#082.dst: Desde que fomos separados do resto de Fruma, não recebemos mais os frutos desse trabalho, embora às vezes clãs antigoverno roubem esses produtos das muitas carroças de suprimentos da Coroa que passam pela área.

Aldwell Library#083.src: Tolas' many farms are built upon a beautiful, open, sprawling plain, where wildlife such as deer live in relative harmony with humans.
Aldwell Library#083.dst: As muitas fazendas de Tolas ficam numa planície linda, aberta e extensa, onde cervos e afins vivem em relativa harmonia com humanos.

Aldwell Library#084.src: Although the people there make open their growing dissatisfaction with Sovereign Amastli's traditionalist policy, they generally live happy lives.
Aldwell Library#084.dst: Embora o povo de lá expresse abertamente seu crescente descontento com a política tradicionalista do Soberano Amastli, em geral vive feliz.

Aldwell Library#085.src: To the south are the Great Mines. As the name would suggest, this section of the province has long been devoted to quarrying for resources. and, like the Agricultural District, is home to a full populace of workers.
Aldwell Library#085.dst: Ao sul ficam as Grandes Minas. Como diz o nome, esta parte da província há muito se dedica à extração de recursos e, como o Distrito Agrícola, abriga uma população inteira de trabalhadores.

Aldwell Library#086.src: The actual surface geography of the Great Mines is mostly indistinct from its neighbours.
Aldwell Library#086.dst: A geografia de superfície das Grandes Minas mal se distingue da de suas vizinhas.

Aldwell Library#087.src: What differentiates the region from others is the number of valuable natural resources under the ground. As such, a wall has been built to indicate the divide between there and here.
Aldwell Library#087.dst: O que distingue a região das outras é a quantidade de recursos naturais valiosos no subsolo. Por isso, um muro foi construído para marcar a divisa entre lá e aqui.

Aldwell Library#088.src: Most of the area's citizens live in the central mining hub, Deraj, rather than any smaller settlements as seen in other regions. Since the end of the Cursed Age, they have been endlessly, passionately mining for Fruma.
Aldwell Library#088.dst: A maioria dos cidadãos vive no núcleo minerador central, Deraj, e não em povoados menores como em outras regiões. Desde o fim da Era Maldita, mineram para Fruma sem parar e com paixão.

Aldwell Library#089.src: At the beginning of the Knowledge Age, when Sovereign Oru ascended, these mining operations intensified, in search of Cinnabar. Some parts of the Great Mines have since become quite worn down.
Aldwell Library#089.dst: No início da Era do Conhecimento, quando o Soberano Oru ascendeu, a mineração se intensificou em busca de cinábrio. Desde então, partes das Grandes Minas ficaram bem desgastadas.

Aldwell Library#090.src: North of the {p} are the {p}, the most affluent region of Fruma. This region is a hilly moor home to all kinds of gorgeous flowers and other such plants, including trees with fruits that flower pink.
Aldwell Library#090.dst: Ao norte de {p} ficam {p}, a região mais rica de Fruma. É uma charneca de colinas com todo tipo de flores lindas e outras plantas, incluindo árvores frutíferas de flores rosa.

Aldwell Library#091.src: The area is embroiled in a constant soft power struggle among various influential families, though one particular family - called the Nasins - have quite consistently maintained supremacy. Their patriarch, Gitephe, is the region's Sovereign.
Aldwell Library#091.dst: A área vive numa constante disputa velada de poder entre famílias influentes, mas uma família em particular - os Nasin - mantém a supremacia de forma bem constante. Seu patriarca, Gitephe, é o Soberano da região.

Aldwell Library#092.src: Within this region is the gate to {p}, and so, a large amount of the province's trade must pass through it.
Aldwell Library#092.dst: Nesta região fica o portão de {p}, por isso grande parte do comércio da província tem de passar por ele.

Aldwell Library#093.src: This is problematic for the Crown, as the {p} are the only way up into the {p}, and our clans frequently attempt to rob supply wagons.
Aldwell Library#093.dst: Isso é um problema para a Coroa, pois {p} são a única subida até {p}, e nossos clãs vivem tentando roubar carroças de suprimentos.

Aldwell Library#094.src: Though it neighbours the {p}, they are separated from one another by a sheer difference in height, where the {p} stands.
Aldwell Library#094.dst: Embora faça divisa com {p}, as duas são separadas por um desnível abrupto, onde fica {p}.

Aldwell Library#095.src: The presence of this dam has led to what once was a river becoming a large lake, at the edge of which the region's capital city, {p}, is situated.
Aldwell Library#095.dst: Esta represa fez o que antes era um rio virar um grande lago, em cuja margem fica a capital da região, {p}.

Aldwell Library#096.src: This region is also home to a great variety of fascinating creatures, though, contrary to popular folkloric belief, there aren't any winged snakes.
Aldwell Library#096.dst: Esta região também abriga uma grande variedade de criaturas fascinantes, embora, ao contrário da crença popular, não haja cobras aladas.

Aldwell Library#097.src: In the very heart of Fruma is {p}, the capital city of the province, and home of the Queen. It rests atop a plateau overlooking the surrounding regions, so its looming wall is not a sight unique to our woods.
Aldwell Library#097.dst: No coração de Fruma fica {p}, capital da província e lar da Rainha. Ela fica num planalto acima das regiões vizinhas, então sua muralha imponente não é uma visão exclusiva das nossas matas.

Aldwell Library#098.src: Being in the city is a very unique experience. It is completely unlike the quiet life we live in the woods. There is almost no nature around at all, only buildings; not an inch of land has not been used for construction.
Aldwell Library#098.dst: Estar na cidade é uma experiência única. Nada se parece com a vida tranquila que levamos na mata. Quase não há natureza, só prédios; não há um palmo de terra que não tenha sido construído.

Aldwell Library#099.src: Among the many noteworthy places in the citadel are the military's headquarters, the Royal University, and the Queen's palace.
Aldwell Library#099.dst: Entre os muitos lugares notáveis da cidadela estão o quartel-general do exército, a Universidade Real e o palácio da Rainha.

Aldwell Library#100.src: Those few fortunate enough to see the inside of the palace described it as the height of luxury, exceeding even their wildest imagination. It's a shame that none from these woods may ever see such beauty again.
Aldwell Library#100.dst: Os poucos sortudos que viram o interior do palácio o descreveram como o auge do luxo, além da mais louca imaginação. É uma pena que ninguém destas matas possa ver tal beleza de novo.

Aldwell Library#101.src: According to legends passed down from our forefathers, the plateau was once the best place in the world for viewing the night sky, as the view was almost completely without obstructions.
Aldwell Library#101.dst: Segundo lendas passadas por nossos antepassados, o planalto já foi o melhor lugar do mundo para ver o céu noturno, pois a vista era quase sem obstáculos.

Aldwell Library#102.src: Today, this is no longer true, as the famous city wall obscures most of this view. However, the University is said to have a place for viewing the stars that sees above this border.
Aldwell Library#102.dst: Hoje não é mais assim, pois a famosa muralha tapa quase toda a vista. Porém, dizem que a Universidade tem um lugar para observar as estrelas acima desse limite.

Aldwell Library#103.src: ...It seems to be some sort of children's story book. Would you like to read it?
Aldwell Library#103.dst: ...Parece um tipo de livro de histórias infantis. Quer ler?

Aldwell Library#104.src: This book is called "Sight of Sasha".
Aldwell Library#104.dst: Este livro é "O olhar de Sasha".

Aldwell Library#105.src: Once upon a time, in the land of Uthak, there lived a little boy named Nannah, or so his people called him.
Aldwell Library#105.dst: Era uma vez, na terra de Uthak, um menino chamado Nannah, ou assim seu povo o chamava.

Aldwell Library#106.src: Nannah was a troublesome, mischievous boy, who always disobeyed his elders, and lied to get out of trouble.
Aldwell Library#106.dst: Nannah era um menino levado e travesso, que sempre desobedecia aos mais velhos e mentia para se safar.

Aldwell Library#107.src: One day, his mother took him out foraging in the woods. The woods were a dangerous place, and Nannah had to stay close for his own safety. But he did not want to do that.
Aldwell Library#107.dst: Um dia, sua mãe o levou para colher na mata. A mata era um lugar perigoso, e Nannah tinha de ficar perto para sua segurança. Mas ele não queria.

Aldwell Library#108.src: When his dear mother was busy picking berries, Nannah ran out into the woods, seeking his own adventure, though he did not travel very far, because shortly after he departed, he was stopped by a voice.
Aldwell Library#108.dst: Quando sua querida mãe estava ocupada colhendo frutinhas, Nannah correu para a mata atrás de sua própria aventura, mas não foi muito longe, pois logo depois de partir foi detido por uma voz.

Aldwell Library#109.src: "Nannah, you must stop," said the voice, "It is not good to misbehave."
Aldwell Library#109.dst: "Nannah, pare", disse a voz. "Não é bom se comportar mal."

Aldwell Library#110.src: Nannah turned to the source of the voice, up in the trees. Two big, blue eyes stared back, and the eyes belonged to an owl with beautiful white feathers. "Who are you?" asked Nannah.
Aldwell Library#110.dst: Nannah se virou para a origem da voz, no alto das árvores. Dois grandes olhos azuis o encaravam, de uma coruja de belas penas brancas. "Quem é você?", perguntou Nannah.

Aldwell Library#111.src: "I am Sasha," said the owl, "The judge of Uthak. You must listen to your elders, Nannah, they know best."
Aldwell Library#111.dst: "Sou Sasha", disse a coruja, "a juíza de Uthak. Escute os mais velhos, Nannah, eles sabem mais."

Aldwell Library#112.src: Nannah responded, "Why, Sasha? I have traveled far from my mother, yet I am fine. She was wrong; these woods are safe."
Aldwell Library#112.dst: Nannah respondeu: "Por quê, Sasha? Me afastei muito da minha mãe e estou bem. Ela errou; esta mata é segura."

Aldwell Library#113.src: "Because, Nannah, monsters like me eat naughty children like you. I have been watching your behaviour for a long time, with my eyes that pierce the mists. You must stop being such a disrespectul boy, or else you may become my dinner."
Aldwell Library#113.dst: "Porque, Nannah, monstros como eu comem crianças levadas como você. Observo seu comportamento há muito tempo, com meus olhos que atravessam a névoa. Pare de ser tão desrespeitoso, ou pode virar meu jantar."

Aldwell Library#114.src: Nannah was frightened by this, and ran back to where his mother was. He found her there, calling his name. "Nannah? Nannah!!!" she yelled.
Aldwell Library#114.dst: Nannah se assustou e voltou correndo até a mãe. Ele a encontrou chamando seu nome. "Nannah? Nannah!!!", gritava.

Aldwell Library#115.src: When Nannah approached her, she was very disappointed in him. "You cannot go running off into the forests, Nannah," she said, "It is not safe!"
Aldwell Library#115.dst: Quando Nannah se aproximou, ela ficou muito decepcionada. "Você não pode sair correndo pela floresta, Nannah", disse. "Não é seguro!"

Aldwell Library#116.src: Nannah promised her that he would never venture into the forest alone again. "Are you sure, Nannah?" she said, "A promise is something you ought not break."
Aldwell Library#116.dst: Nannah prometeu nunca mais entrar sozinho na floresta. "Tem certeza, Nannah?", disse ela. "Promessa é algo que não se quebra."

Aldwell Library#117.src: He agreed, and they went home. But, that night, Nannah could not sleep, for an idea kept circling his mind.
Aldwell Library#117.dst: Ele concordou, e voltaram para casa. Mas à noite Nannah não dormiu, pois uma ideia rondava sua cabeça.

Aldwell Library#118.src: "Stupid Sasha," he thought, "Nobody should tell me what I can and cannot do!"
Aldwell Library#118.dst: "Sasha burra", pensou ele. "Ninguém vai me dizer o que posso ou não fazer!"

Aldwell Library#119.src: Nannah, not wanting to be bossed around by the owl, made his decision. He got up from his bed, and tip-toed out of his house. He would break his promise he made to his mother, and ignore Sasha's recommendation.
Aldwell Library#119.dst: Nannah, sem querer ser mandado pela coruja, tomou sua decisão. Levantou-se da cama e saiu de casa na ponta dos pés. Quebraria a promessa feita à mãe e ignoraria o conselho de Sasha.

Aldwell Library#120.src: The forest was dark at night, and barely anything could be seen. The only things Nannah could make out were the Candleferns that dotted the forests.
Aldwell Library#120.dst: A floresta era escura à noite, e quase nada se via. Nannah só conseguia distinguir os Candleferns espalhados pela mata.

Aldwell Library#121.src: Despite the danger of getting lost, Nannah could not bring himself to admit defeat and head home. He walked from Candlefern to Candlefern, for several minutes, until the quiet sounds of the village were gone. It was silent.
Aldwell Library#121.dst: Apesar do perigo de se perder, Nannah não conseguia admitir a derrota e voltar. Andou de Candlefern em Candlefern por vários minutos, até os sons baixos da aldeia sumirem. Fez-se silêncio.

Aldwell Library#122.src: "Hello again," said a familiar voice, "I see you have not learned."
Aldwell Library#122.dst: "Olá de novo", disse uma voz conhecida. "Vejo que não aprendeu."

Aldwell Library#123.src: "Sasha???" yelped Nannah, "How did you get here? I didn't hear you!"
Aldwell Library#123.dst: "Sasha???", gritou Nannah. "Como chegou aqui? Não ouvi você!"

Aldwell Library#124.src: "I am one with the winds, Nannah, my flight is as silent as the mist itself. Nobody can ever hear my approach. It makes me very good at catching naughty children to have for my dinner."
Aldwell Library#124.dst: "Sou uma com os ventos, Nannah, meu voo é silencioso como a própria névoa. Ninguém me ouve chegar. Por isso sou ótima em pegar crianças levadas para o jantar."

Aldwell Library#125.src: Before he knew it, Nannah had been lifted off his feet, and was brought through the darkness to Sasha's wicker nest, never to be seen again.
Aldwell Library#125.dst: Antes que percebesse, Nannah foi erguido do chão e levado pela escuridão até o ninho de vime de Sasha, e nunca mais foi visto.

Aldwell Library#126.src: The mist of our forest home is dense and widespread; many get lost trying to find their way through the fog. As such, our people have devised various methods to remember the area better.
Aldwell Library#126.dst: A névoa do nosso lar na floresta é densa e extensa; muitos se perdem tentando se orientar nela. Por isso, nosso povo criou vários métodos para lembrar melhor a área.

Aldwell Library#127.src: One popular method is learning the Virtuous Trees, a group of distinct trees throughout the woods that embody a set of precepts.
Aldwell Library#127.dst: Um método popular é aprender as Árvores Virtuosas, um grupo de árvores marcantes da mata que encarnam um conjunto de preceitos.

Aldwell Library#128.src: Knowing each of these trees means that they can be used as a reference point if you are lost. They also provide great teachings to live by.
Aldwell Library#128.dst: Conhecer cada uma dessas árvores permite usá-las como ponto de referência se você se perder. Elas também dão grandes lições de vida.

Aldwell Library#129.src: First is the Tree of Community, the single tree specimen that {p} is built around. Indeed, the trees of {p} are in fact one single specimen, grown from one tree in what is called a "clonal colony."
Aldwell Library#129.dst: A primeira é a Árvore da Comunidade, o único espécime em torno do qual {p} foi construída. Aliás, as árvores de {p} são um só espécime, crescido de uma árvore no que se chama "colônia clonal".

Aldwell Library#130.src: This tree represents the importance of community and family; that, despite our differences, and our aggressions, we are all one, and must ultimately cooperate to build each other up.
Aldwell Library#130.dst: Esta árvore representa a importância da comunidade e da família; que, apesar das diferenças e agressões, somos todos um e devemos, no fim, cooperar para nos elevar uns aos outros.

Aldwell Library#131.src: Second is the Tree of Altruism, a distinctly different Redwood thanks to its small size and white leaves.
Aldwell Library#131.dst: A segunda é a Árvore do Altruísmo, uma sequoia bem diferente pelo porte pequeno e folhas brancas.

Aldwell Library#132.src: This tree is in fact an Albino Redwood, and it is believed that its frail appearance is the result of an assistance it provides to its fellow trees.
Aldwell Library#132.dst: Esta árvore é na verdade uma sequoia albina, e acredita-se que sua aparência frágil vem da ajuda que ela dá às árvores vizinhas.

Aldwell Library#133.src: It is located in the far east side of the {p}, and demonstrates that we should strive to help others, even if at great personal cost.
Aldwell Library#133.dst: Ela fica no extremo leste de {p} e mostra que devemos nos esforçar para ajudar os outros, mesmo a um grande custo pessoal.

Aldwell Library#134.src: Third is the Tree of Renewal, a truly ancient tree that is believed to be one of the first trees in the forest, and among the tallest of all. It is thought to have lived through countless disasters, and healed from each.
Aldwell Library#134.dst: A terceira é a Árvore da Renovação, uma árvore muito antiga que se crê ser uma das primeiras da floresta e das mais altas de todas. Acredita-se que sobreviveu a inúmeros desastres e se curou de cada um.

Aldwell Library#135.src: The Tree of Renewal shows that we should take time to rest and heal; to prioritize our own wellbeing when it is necessary, rather than solely sticking to altruism alone.
Aldwell Library#135.dst: A Árvore da Renovação mostra que devemos tirar tempo para descansar e sarar; priorizar nosso bem-estar quando preciso, em vez de nos apegar só ao altruísmo.

Aldwell Library#136.src: Fourth and final is the Tree of Resistance, a towering, resilient tree that is home to The Canopy Clan.
Aldwell Library#136.dst: A quarta e última é a Árvore da Resistência, uma árvore altíssima e resistente, lar do clã do Dossel.

Aldwell Library#137.src: Though outwardly unremarkable, its location is important to consider. It stands in deforested land, yet lives on, thriving despite the destruction of its habitat. It symbolizes our collective resistance to oppressors.
Aldwell Library#137.dst: Embora comum por fora, sua localização importa. Ela fica em terra desmatada, mas segue viva, prosperando apesar da destruição de seu habitat. Simboliza nossa resistência coletiva aos opressores.

Aldwell Library#138.src: Remember these trees, and their virtues. It may save your life, and guide you to great friendships.
Aldwell Library#138.dst: Lembre-se destas árvores e de suas virtudes. Podem salvar sua vida e guiá-lo a grandes amizades.

An Unexpected Departure#001.src: This plaque has clearly seen erosion over time, but you can still make out most of the text.
An Unexpected Departure#001.dst: Esta placa sofreu erosão com o tempo, mas você ainda distingue a maior parte do texto.

An Unexpected Departure#002.src: "This monument has been built in memory of those who perished following a terrible attack initiated by enemies of the state."
An Unexpected Departure#002.dst: "Este monumento foi erguido em memória dos que pereceram após um terrível ataque iniciado por inimigos do Estado."

An Unexpected Departure#003.src: "Forever shall the workers have strength, and rise above those who wish to destroy our glorious way of life."
An Unexpected Departure#003.dst: "Que os trabalhadores sejam sempre fortes e superem os que querem destruir nosso glorioso modo de vida."

An Unexpected Departure#004.src: The rake collides with the statue, damaging it a bit.
An Unexpected Departure#004.dst: O rastelo bate na estátua e a danifica um pouco.

An Unexpected Departure#007.src: The rope tenses under the weight of the log.
An Unexpected Departure#007.dst: A corda se tensiona sob o peso do tronco.

An Unexpected Departure#008.src: The rope starts to fray, adding any more weight will make it snap.
An Unexpected Departure#008.dst: A corda começa a desfiar; mais peso vai fazê-la arrebentar.

An Unexpected Departure#009.src: It looks like there's enough space in this to fit at least three items.
An Unexpected Departure#009.dst: Parece haver espaço aqui para pelo menos três itens.
