Solace in Pain#005.dst: Fora isso, o pessoal gosta deste parquinho. É bem cuidado.
Solace in Pain#005.speaker: Espren Guard

Solace in Pain#006.src: Ask someone else if you're some sort of tourist.
Solace in Pain#006.dst: Se é algum tipo de turista, pergunte a outro.
Solace in Pain#006.speaker: Espren Guard

Solace in Pain#007.src: If you need something, say it here and now.
Solace in Pain#007.dst: Se precisa de algo, diga aqui e agora.
Solace in Pain#007.speaker: Espren Guard

Solace in Pain#008.src: Maybe that gardener has something for headaches?
Solace in Pain#008.dst: Será que a jardineira tem algo pra dor de cabeça?
Solace in Pain#008.speaker: Espren Guard

Solace in Pain#009.src: Can't help. Go rest somewhere or something.
Solace in Pain#009.dst: Não posso ajudar. Vá descansar, sei lá.
Solace in Pain#009.speaker: Espren Guard

Solace in Pain#010.src: Can I help you with anything?
Solace in Pain#010.speaker: Espren Citizen

Solace in Pain#011.src: I will say though, it can get somewhat displeasing when you feel watched all the time...
Solace in Pain#011.dst: Mas devo dizer, é meio desagradável se sentir vigiado o tempo todo...
Solace in Pain#011.speaker: Espren Citizen

Solace in Pain#012.src: Despite this, it is a small public place people can relax in.
Solace in Pain#012.dst: Mesmo assim, é um pequeno espaço público onde se pode relaxar.
Solace in Pain#012.speaker: Espren Citizen

Solace in Pain#013.src: This is the entrance to the manor of Sovereign Zhiraok.
Solace in Pain#013.dst: Esta é a entrada da mansão do Soberano Zhiraok.
Solace in Pain#013.speaker: Espren Citizen

Solace in Pain#014.src: I'm not too certain myself, but I do find them neat-looking.
Solace in Pain#014.dst: Também não tenho certeza, mas acho bonitas.
Solace in Pain#014.speaker: Espren Citizen

Solace in Pain#015.src: I think... They represent growth, harmony, and things of this nature.
Solace in Pain#015.dst: Acho que... representam crescimento, harmonia e coisas assim.
Solace in Pain#015.speaker: Espren Citizen

Solace in Pain#016.src: Ah, you're wondering about the statues?
Solace in Pain#016.dst: Ah, está curioso sobre as estátuas?
Solace in Pain#016.speaker: Espren Citizen

Solace in Pain#018.src: I mean... The two guards here never move. At all.
Solace in Pain#018.dst: Quer dizer... Os dois guardas daqui nunca se mexem.
Solace in Pain#018.speaker: Espren Citizen

Solace in Pain#019.src: Well, they rarely move. It happens when a crime is reported to them.
Solace in Pain#019.dst: Bem, raramente se mexem. Só quando alguém denuncia um crime.
Solace in Pain#019.speaker: Espren Citizen

Solace in Pain#020.src: I wouldn't be surprised if they were bored of staying here all day... I know I couldn't just stand still for so long.
Solace in Pain#020.dst: Não me surpreenderia se estivessem entediados de ficar aqui o dia todo... Eu não conseguiria ficar parada tanto tempo.
Solace in Pain#020.speaker: Espren Citizen

Solace in Pain#021.src: I suppose they're just doing their job? Nevertheless, I like this spot, and I'd like it if it was a bit more... Empty.
Solace in Pain#021.dst: Acho que só estão fazendo o trabalho deles? Mesmo assim, gosto deste lugar, e gostaria que fosse um pouco mais... vazio.
Solace in Pain#021.speaker: Espren Citizen

Solace in Pain#024.src: Why do you ask? Who are you? I've never seen you before. And I see a lot of people.
Solace in Pain#024.dst: Por que pergunta? Quem é você? Nunca te vi antes. E eu vejo muita gente.
Solace in Pain#024.speaker: Gardener

Solace in Pain#025.src: I'd be doing a lot better if I could see the view from the balcony above...
Solace in Pain#025.dst: Eu estaria bem melhor se pudesse ver a vista da sacada lá de cima...
Solace in Pain#025.speaker: Gardener

Solace in Pain#026.src: This mansion over here? It sure is!
Solace in Pain#026.speaker: Gardener

Solace in Pain#027.src: Ah, to be blessed with such a job... Working for him... I might be the luckiest person in Auburn!
Solace in Pain#027.dst: Ah, ter a bênção de um emprego assim... Trabalhar para ele... Devo ser a mais sortuda de Auburn!
Solace in Pain#027.speaker: Gardener

Solace in Pain#028.src: What? Don't you find him incredible? And pretty, too!
Solace in Pain#028.dst: O quê? Não acha ele incrível? E bonito, também!
Solace in Pain#028.speaker: Gardener

Solace in Pain#029.src: He sometimes shows up on his balcony right here. I'd love knowing what's in there...
Solace in Pain#029.dst: Às vezes ele aparece na sacada bem aqui. Adoraria saber o que tem lá dentro...
Solace in Pain#029.speaker: Gardener

Solace in Pain#030.src: Can't you see all the guards around? Why come to ME to report something?
Solace in Pain#030.dst: Não vê os guardas por aí? Por que vir até MIM denunciar algo?
Solace in Pain#030.speaker: Gardener

Solace in Pain#031.src: In fact... If you could get them off this little place for a bit, that'd be nice.
Solace in Pain#031.dst: Aliás... Se você conseguisse tirá-los deste cantinho por um tempo, seria ótimo.
Solace in Pain#031.speaker: Gardener

Solace in Pain#032.src: I'd enjoy some more peace and quiet. Being the one taking care of everything here, I think I deserve it.
Solace in Pain#032.dst: Eu adoraria mais paz e sossego. Como sou eu que cuido de tudo aqui, acho que mereço.
Solace in Pain#032.speaker: Gardener

Solace in Pain#033.src: If you're that eager to have a chat, why don't you go and report a crime or something?
Solace in Pain#033.dst: Se está tão ansioso pra conversar, por que não vai denunciar um crime ou algo assim?
Solace in Pain#033.speaker: Gardener

Solace in Pain#034.src: Access to the mansion is strictly forbidden. What is it?
Solace in Pain#034.dst: O acesso à mansão é estritamente proibido. O que foi?
Solace in Pain#034.speaker: Gardener

Solace in Pain#036.src: Here? This is a good place to clear one's mind. The fountain and the sights make it good for meditation.
Solace in Pain#036.dst: Aqui? É um bom lugar para clarear a mente. A fonte e a vista o tornam bom para meditar.
Solace in Pain#036.speaker: Espren Guard

Solace in Pain#038.src: I'm sorry to hear that, but I can't help you.
Solace in Pain#038.speaker: Espren Guard

Solace in Pain#039.src: I recommend sitting on the stump over yonder and taking a break, see if that helps.
Solace in Pain#039.dst: Recomendo sentar naquele toco ali e descansar um pouco, veja se ajuda.
Solace in Pain#039.speaker: Espren Guard

Solace in Pain#041.src: My apologies, but you cannot see him unless summoned by him.
Solace in Pain#041.dst: Perdão, mas não pode vê-lo a menos que ele o convoque.
Solace in Pain#041.speaker: Espren Guard

Solace in Pain#042.src: If the matter is urgent, you may report to a guard.
Solace in Pain#042.dst: Se o assunto for urgente, fale com um guarda.
Solace in Pain#042.speaker: Gardener

Solace in Pain#043.src: ..and I told you I'm not the one to go to.
Solace in Pain#043.dst: ..e já disse que não é comigo.
Solace in Pain#043.speaker: Gardener

Solace in Pain#044.src: If you have something to report, please talk to someone else.
Solace in Pain#044.dst: Se tem algo a denunciar, fale com outra pessoa, por favor.
Solace in Pain#044.speaker: Gardener

Solace in Pain#045.src: The guards are always more than happy to take care of problems.
Solace in Pain#045.dst: Os guardas sempre adoram cuidar de problemas.
Solace in Pain#045.speaker: Gardener

Solace in Pain#046.src: Someone's trying to sneak inside the mansion..?
Solace in Pain#046.dst: Alguém tentando entrar escondido na mansão..?
Solace in Pain#046.speaker: Espren Guard

Solace in Pain#047.src: But that's impossible. There are guards all around. This is the only entrance.
Solace in Pain#047.dst: Mas é impossível. Há guardas por toda parte. Esta é a única entrada.
Solace in Pain#047.speaker: Espren Guard

Solace in Pain#048.src: Maybe you saw something else. Apologies, but we'll stay here.
Solace in Pain#048.dst: Talvez tenha visto outra coisa. Desculpe, mas ficaremos aqui.
Solace in Pain#048.speaker: Espren Guard

Solace in Pain#049.src: A cursed one? Are you certain?
Solace in Pain#049.speaker: Espren Guard

Solace in Pain#050.src: We'll go look for them for a bit. Thank you.
Solace in Pain#050.dst: Vamos procurá-lo por um tempo. Obrigado.
Solace in Pain#050.speaker: Espren Guard

Solace in Pain#052.src:
Gardener:
Hey, couldn't I sneak into
Zhiraok's balcony..?
Solace in Pain#052.dst:
Jardineira:
Ei, e se eu entrasse escondida
na sacada do Zhiraok..?
Solace in Pain#052.speaker: Gardener

Solace in Pain#053.dst:
Cidadão de {p}:
Se ao menos eu pudesse...
*resmunga*
Solace in Pain#053.speaker: Espren Citizen

Solace in Pain#054.src:
Gardener:
That'd be crazy...
Let's just enjoy this!
Solace in Pain#054.dst:
Jardineira:
Seria loucura...
Vamos só aproveitar!
Solace in Pain#054.speaker: Gardener

Solace in Pain#055.dst:
Cidadão de {p}:
Mas aí... Aí o quê..?
*resmunga*
Solace in Pain#055.speaker: Espren Citizen

Solace in Pain#058.src:
Gardener:
Ah, they're coming back...
Bummer.
Solace in Pain#058.dst:
Jardineira:
Ah, estão voltando...
Que pena.
Solace in Pain#058.speaker: Gardener

Solace in Pain#060.dst:
Cidadão de {p}:
O que está acontecendo?
Solace in Pain#060.speaker: Espren Citizen

Solace in Pain#061.src:
{p} Guard:
Report. Come with me to check.
Solace in Pain#061.dst:
Guarda de {p}:
Denúncia. Venha comigo verificar.
Solace in Pain#061.speaker: Espren Guard

Solace in Pain#066.src: Did you... Did you say something to them?
Solace in Pain#066.dst: Você... Você disse algo a eles?
Solace in Pain#066.speaker: Gardener

Solace in Pain#067.src: Well, no matter. I don't get to experience this often.
Solace in Pain#067.dst: Bem, tanto faz. Não é sempre que tenho isso.
Solace in Pain#067.speaker: Gardener

Solace in Pain#068.src: They'll probably be back soon anyway...
Solace in Pain#068.dst: Devem voltar logo de qualquer jeito...
Solace in Pain#068.speaker: Gardener

Solace in Pain#069.src: At least now there's no one to give me weird looks when I try to climb up the bench!
Solace in Pain#069.dst: Pelo menos agora ninguém me olha torto quando tento subir no banco!
Solace in Pain#069.speaker: Gardener

Solace in Pain#071.src: Enjoy this brief moment of peace. I know I will.
Solace in Pain#071.dst: Aproveite este breve momento de paz. Eu vou.
Solace in Pain#071.speaker: Espren Citizen

Solace in Pain#072.src: Maybe there's something to do while they're away..?
Solace in Pain#072.dst: Talvez haja algo a fazer enquanto estão fora..?
Solace in Pain#072.speaker: Espren Citizen

Solace in Pain#073.src: There are various letters lying around...

Solace in Pain#074.src: Some seem to be addressed to the sovereign Soosu.
Solace in Pain#074.dst: Algumas parecem endereçadas à soberana Soosu.

Solace in Pain#075.src: Tucked away is a letter about a "newly-ascended" sovereign...?
Solace in Pain#075.dst: Escondida há uma carta sobre um soberano "recém-ascendido"...?

Solace in Pain#076.src: Footsteps can be heard in the building. You can't linger on these letters for too long, just in case someone comes in.
Solace in Pain#076.dst: Ouvem-se passos no prédio. Não dá pra se demorar nessas cartas, caso alguém entre.

Solace in Pain#077.src: A large wardrobe. Opening it reveals...

Solace in Pain#078.src: Dozens of the exact same battle-ready suit covering up a few more casual outfits.
Solace in Pain#078.dst: Dezenas do mesmo traje de combate, cobrindo algumas roupas mais casuais.

Solace in Pain#080.dst: Um armário cheio e sem graça.

Solace in Pain#082.src: A large wardrobe. It's filled with various clothing garments, but...
Solace in Pain#082.dst: Um grande guarda-roupa. Cheio de roupas variadas, mas...

Solace in Pain#083.src: It looks like a person could fit inside.
Solace in Pain#083.dst: Parece que caberia uma pessoa dentro.

Solace in Pain#084.src: This seems to be Zhiraok's journal. Maybe there's some insight on him in here.
Solace in Pain#084.dst: Parece ser o diário de Zhiraok. Talvez revele algo sobre ele.

Solace in Pain#085.src: You open the journal to a random page.
Solace in Pain#085.dst: Você abre o diário numa página qualquer.

Solace in Pain#086.src: I already knew about my speaking. But after reviewing my records, I've apparently been letting it leak into my writing, too!!
Solace in Pain#086.dst: Eu já sabia do meu jeito de falar. Mas, revendo meus registros, pelo visto deixei isso vazar pra escrita também!!

Solace in Pain#087.src: I constantly have to keep the to-do list in the back of my head. I constantly have to crunch the numbers to figure out what I can do, and how it can be dealt with most efficiently...
Solace in Pain#087.dst: Preciso manter a lista de tarefas sempre no fundo da cabeça. Preciso fazer contas o tempo todo pra saber o que posso fazer e como resolver da forma mais eficiente...

Solace in Pain#088.src: It's an active effort to avoid letting my mouth spew the calculations I'm always running in my head now. I can handle it for a while, but it'll slip through eventually, I notice.
Solace in Pain#088.dst: Agora é um esforço ativo evitar que minha boca despeje os cálculos que vivo fazendo na cabeça. Aguento por um tempo, mas uma hora escapa, eu percebo.

Solace in Pain#089.src: At this point, with how common it is, I might never get rid of it. I've moved the goal to just keeping it from becoming impenetrably overburdened with whatever euphemisms my brain involuntarily tosses into my speech.
Solace in Pain#089.dst: A esta altura, de tão comum, talvez eu nunca me livre disso. Mudei a meta para só impedir que minha fala fique impenetravelmente carregada dos eufemismos que meu cérebro joga nela sem querer.

Solace in Pain#090.src: I already get some stares, some questions- I utterly baffled a group of kids the other day just trying to answer some innocent questions. How will I address the peoples' needs if I can only talk numbers?
Solace in Pain#090.dst: Já recebo uns olhares, umas perguntas- outro dia deixei um grupo de crianças totalmente confuso só tentando responder perguntas inocentes. Como vou atender o povo se só sei falar em números?

Solace in Pain#091.src: Maybe this will make more sense if you read in the proper order...
Solace in Pain#091.dst: Talvez faça mais sentido se você ler na ordem certa...

Solace in Pain#093.src: A diverse wardrobe, with empty room in the middle.
Solace in Pain#093.dst: Um guarda-roupa variado, com espaço vazio no meio.

Solace in Pain#095.src: I'm positive this isn't how honor is supposed to feel. The manor gardener has been...insistently admiring me. Does she think I don't notice? It's distracting!
Solace in Pain#095.dst: Tenho certeza de que a honra não deveria ser assim. A jardineira da mansão anda... me admirando com insistência. Acha que não percebo? Isso distrai!

Solace in Pain#096.src: I'd prefer to be respected for the problems I've solved and the actions I take, rather than because people think I'm...aesthetically pleasing. It's odd how often it happens.
Solace in Pain#096.dst: Prefiro ser respeitado pelos problemas que resolvi e pelas ações que tomo, não porque acham que sou... esteticamente agradável. É estranho como acontece tanto.

Solace in Pain#097.src: The opinion in Auburn still fluctuates. Some still can't get past my name. Some think it doesn't matter. I want it to matter.
Solace in Pain#097.dst: A opinião em Auburn ainda oscila. Alguns ainda não superam meu sobrenome. Outros acham que não importa. Eu quero que importe.

Solace in Pain#098.src: The whole point is for the name to matter! They should associate my solutions with the Nasin name. That's the endpoint.
Solace in Pain#098.dst: O objetivo é justamente que o nome importe! Devem associar minhas soluções ao nome Nasin. Esse é o resultado final.

Solace in Pain#099.src: How could I have miscalculated so badly? {p}'s been decimated. No matter how I approach the question, I'm coming up blank.
Solace in Pain#099.dst: Como calculei tão mal? {p} foi dizimada. Por qualquer ângulo que eu veja a questão, o resultado dá zero.

Solace in Pain#100.src: Are the Cursed really so powerful? What is it about the Curse that makes them so destructive? Purificatus non consumptus...is that a possibility?
Solace in Pain#100.dst: Os Amaldiçoados são mesmo tão poderosos? O que a Maldição tem que os torna tão destrutivos? Purificatus non consumptus... é uma possibilidade?

Solace in Pain#101.src: The Blessed can be constructive. But the Cursed, always destructive. What's the difference? There must be one.
Solace in Pain#101.dst: Os Abençoados podem construir. Mas os Amaldiçoados sempre destroem. Qual é a diferença? Tem que haver uma.

Solace in Pain#102.src: This is a problem I've got to solve. There can't be another massacre like this. I won't fail again like that.
Solace in Pain#102.dst: É um problema que preciso resolver. Não pode haver outro massacre assim. Não vou falhar assim de novo.

Solace in Pain#103.src: You. You, you, you, YOU. If only you'd never been. If only you'd never acted so irrational.
Solace in Pain#103.dst: Você. Você, você, você, VOCÊ. Quem dera nunca tivesse existido. Nem agido sem razão.

Solace in Pain#104.src: To serve is an honor. Was your tantrum worth it? Where was your endpoint? Your sequence has ended by now.
Solace in Pain#104.dst: Servir é uma honra. Valeu a pena sua birra? Qual era seu resultado final? Sua sequência já terminou.

Solace in Pain#105.src: I almost wish it hadn't. I wish I could get my hands around you. Make you see what you left behind before I terminated you myself.
Solace in Pain#105.dst: Quase queria que não tivesse. Queria pôr as mãos em você. Fazer você ver o que deixou para trás antes de eu mesmo te eliminar.

Solace in Pain#106.src: The work here is worth it. The people are worth it. Even dealing with Thalas is worth it. You were a stupid girl who never knew the value of what she had.
Solace in Pain#106.dst: O trabalho aqui vale a pena. O povo vale a pena. Até lidar com Thalas vale a pena. Você era uma garota tola que nunca soube o valor do que tinha.

Solace in Pain#108.src: This seems to be Zhiraok's journal. There's more in the room to investigate,. though. Might be wise to come back to this afterwards.
Solace in Pain#108.dst: Parece ser o diário de Zhiraok. Mas há mais o que investigar no quarto. Talvez seja melhor voltar a isto depois.

Solace in Pain#109.src: You silently open the first page of the book and begin reading...
Solace in Pain#109.dst: Você abre em silêncio a primeira página do livro e começa a ler...

Solace in Pain#111.src: Not for one second can you forget the day you were given the greatest chance of your life.
Solace in Pain#111.dst: Nem por um segundo pode esquecer o dia em que recebeu a maior chance da sua vida.

Solace in Pain#112.src: The day you reached these heights. Began your reclamation.
Solace in Pain#112.dst: O dia em que alcançou estas alturas. Começou sua redenção.

Solace in Pain#115.dst: Encontre um lugar para se esconder!

Solace in Pain#116.src: You need to find a hiding place. Now!
Solace in Pain#116.dst: Você precisa achar um esconderijo. Já!

Solace in Pain#117.src: You silently open the first page of the book, but...
Solace in Pain#117.dst: Você abre em silêncio a primeira página, mas...

Solace in Pain#118.src: Footsteps are approaching! You must hide!

Solace in Pain#119.src: Hello? Xao? I thought I heard someone up here.
Solace in Pain#119.dst: Olá? Xao? Achei ter ouvido alguém aqui em cima.
Solace in Pain#119.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Solace in Pain#122.src: He would never have left my office out of order like this.
Solace in Pain#122.dst: Ele nunca deixaria meu escritório bagunçado assim.
Solace in Pain#122.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Solace in Pain#123.src: Who the helix is in here?!
Solace in Pain#123.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Solace in Pain#125.src: Reach your endpoint! I've got some problems myself.
Solace in Pain#125.dst: Vá ao resultado! Também tenho meus problemas.
Solace in Pain#125.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Solace in Pain#126.src: Reports of a Cursed One in {p}'s walls! Too many to be coincidence. We need your guidance on how to proceed, sir!
Solace in Pain#126.dst: Denúncias de um Amaldiçoado nas muralhas de {p}! Muitas para ser coincidência. Precisamos de suas ordens, senhor!
Solace in Pain#126.speaker: Espren Guard

Solace in Pain#127.src: ...that's a greater value than my concerns, for sure. Alright, follow my lead.
Solace in Pain#127.dst: ...isso tem valor maior que minhas preocupações, sem dúvida. Certo, sigam-me.
Solace in Pain#127.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Solace in Pain#129.src: It's probably safe to read some of the journal before he comes back.
Solace in Pain#129.dst: Deve ser seguro ler um pouco do diário antes que ele volte.

Solace in Pain#131.src: ...this shelf has different books from the rest.
Solace in Pain#131.dst: ...esta estante tem livros diferentes do resto.

Solace in Pain#132.src: It's...more journals. How many of these has he kept?
Solace in Pain#132.dst: São... mais diários. Quantos desses ele guardou?

Solace in Pain#133.src: There's quite a lot of them packed into the shelf.
Solace in Pain#133.dst: Há muitos deles apertados na estante.

Solace in Pain#134.src: The first pages on each seem to be the exact same entry.
Solace in Pain#134.dst: As primeiras páginas de cada um parecem a mesma entrada.

Solace in Pain#135.src: You carefully go back to the start of the book...
Solace in Pain#135.dst: Você volta com cuidado ao início do livro...

Solace in Pain#136.src: When Her Majesty took apart your soul, and rearranged it- set you on your path to perfection.
Solace in Pain#136.dst: Quando Sua Majestade desmontou sua alma e a rearranjou- pôs você no caminho da perfeição.

Solace in Pain#137.src: There has been nothing like what I saw that day, what I felt that day, on any day since then.
Solace in Pain#137.dst: Nunca houve nada como o que vi aquele dia, o que senti aquele dia, em nenhum dia desde então.

Solace in Pain#138.src: The others were impassive. All but Soosu. Was it pity I saw on her face? For the pain...but pain is worth the progress, isn't it?
Solace in Pain#138.dst: Os outros estavam impassíveis. Todos menos Soosu. Era pena no rosto dela? Pela dor... mas a dor vale o progresso, não vale?

Solace in Pain#139.src: To be helpless, surrounded by immortal onlookers, writhing in pain and struggling to stay conscious... A balanced equation, I could say, for what I gained.
Solace in Pain#139.dst: Estar indefeso, cercado de espectadores imortais, me contorcendo de dor e lutando para não desmaiar... Uma equação equilibrada, eu diria, pelo que ganhei.

Solace in Pain#140.src: Ever since, there's been a pinprick sensation in the back of my head, like a hole with lightning crackling on the other end. It's always there, threatening to widen and roar through if I don't keep moving.
Solace in Pain#140.dst: Desde então, sinto uma pontada na nuca, como um buraco com raios estalando do outro lado. Está sempre lá, ameaçando se alargar e irromper rugindo se eu não seguir em movimento.

Solace in Pain#141.src: For my goals, to serve the people, to un-stain the Nasin name, I have to keep working. Her Blessing is perfect for that. That pinprick sensation keeps me sharp.
Solace in Pain#141.dst: Por meus objetivos, servir o povo, limpar o nome Nasin, preciso continuar trabalhando. A Bênção Dela é perfeita para isso. Essa pontada me mantém afiado.

Solace in Pain#142.src: The pain is worth the progress. Any amount of pain is worth any amount of progress. It keeps me attentive like nothing else.
Solace in Pain#142.dst: A dor vale o progresso. Qualquer quantidade de dor vale qualquer quantidade de progresso. Me mantém atento como nada mais.

Solace in Pain#143.src: Remain grateful for the pain...and look forward to the day the work is done, and that hole will finally close.
Solace in Pain#143.dst: Seja grato pela dor... e aguarde o dia em que o trabalho estiver feito, e esse buraco enfim se fechar.

Solace in Pain#144.src: ...it probably isn't smart to stay here for much longer.
Solace in Pain#144.dst: ...não é bom ficar aqui muito mais tempo.

Temple of Swords#001.src: How did you open this door? It's been sealed for as long as I remember.
Temple of Swords#001.speaker: Junes

Temple of Swords#002.src: However... This barrier doesn't look like it was made by the empire.
Temple of Swords#002.speaker: Junes

Temple of Swords#003.src: It's still old, though. Let's give it a little nudge.
Temple of Swords#003.speaker: Junes

Temple of Swords#004.src: Well, it seems to have fallen apart to the touch. This is one of the biggest rooms I've seen..
Temple of Swords#004.speaker: Junes

Temple of Swords#005.src: This must have been important... Let's go!
Temple of Swords#005.speaker: Junes

Temple of Swords#006.src: Don't you think this vault is a little grand for storing just gold?
Temple of Swords#006.speaker: Junes

Temple of Swords#007.src: Look, there's a pedestal for something here, like a weapon.
Temple of Swords#007.speaker: Junes

Temple of Swords#008.src: The dust is disturbed around it. Someone has been here recently..
Temple of Swords#008.speaker: Junes

Temple of Swords#009.src: But why would they take whatever was here, but not all the gold?
Temple of Swords#009.speaker: Junes

Temple of Swords#010.src: Whatever was kept here, I think we can assume it was of great value to the Emperor.
Temple of Swords#010.speaker: Junes

Temple of Swords#011.src: We better get out of here, and don't even think about taking this gold - They are artifacts!
Temple of Swords#011.speaker: Junes

Temple Ruin#000.src: Did you open this place up? You've done some serious damage!
Temple Ruin#000.dst: Foi você que abriu este lugar? Você causou um belo estrago!
Temple Ruin#000.speaker: Junes

Temple Ruin#001.src: It might not look like much, but these ruins were left by a now extinct empire.
Temple Ruin#001.dst: Pode não parecer muito, mas estas ruínas são de um império já extinto.
Temple Ruin#001.speaker: Junes

Temple Ruin#002.src: I spent half a year excavating this place.. I must admit it would have taken me {~} years to finish. Alright, let's go deeper. Try to keep up.
Temple Ruin#002.dst: Passei meio ano escavando este lugar.. Admito que levaria {~} anos para terminar. Certo, vamos mais fundo. Tente acompanhar.
Temple Ruin#002.speaker: Junes

Temple Ruin#003.src: Amazing, isn't it? This is just an ordinary building in the old empire that lies beneath the sands.
Temple Ruin#003.dst: Incrível, não? Isto é só um prédio comum do antigo império que jaz sob as areias.
Temple Ruin#003.speaker: Junes

Temple Ruin#004.src: We don't know much about them, but we are uncovering more and more every day.
Temple Ruin#004.dst: Não sabemos muito sobre eles, mas descobrimos mais a cada dia.
Temple Ruin#004.speaker: Junes

Temple Ruin#005.src: Follow me, there is so much to take in.
Temple Ruin#005.speaker: Junes

Temple Ruin#006.src: It's clear that the empire was seriously advanced, possibly more advanced than us in some ways.
Temple Ruin#006.dst: Está claro que o império era muito avançado, talvez mais que nós em alguns aspectos.
Temple Ruin#006.speaker: Junes

Temple Ruin#007.src: I keep seeing symbols in every building.. It looks like some kind of rod or sceptre.
Temple Ruin#007.dst: Vejo símbolos em todos os prédios.. Parece algum tipo de bastão ou cetro.
Temple Ruin#007.speaker: Junes

Temple Ruin#008.src: We know that there was an emperor that ruled these lands, this must be the source of his power.
Temple Ruin#008.dst: Sabemos que um imperador governou estas terras, esta deve ser a fonte do poder dele.
Temple Ruin#008.speaker: Junes

Temple Ruin#009.src: Hmm, I'm going to continue researching this place, but I think I might be able to figure a way out for you.
Temple Ruin#009.dst: Hmm, vou continuar pesquisando este lugar, mas acho que consigo achar uma saída para você.
Temple Ruin#009.speaker: Junes

Temple Ruin#011.src: Howdy feller! This here is my cactus stand.
Temple Ruin#011.dst: E aí, parceiro! Esta aqui é minha barraca de cactos.
Temple Ruin#011.speaker: Cactus Expert

Temple Ruin#012.src: I travel all across the desert, cutting down cactus for the juice!
Temple Ruin#012.dst: Eu viajo pelo deserto inteiro, cortando cactos pelo suco!
Temple Ruin#012.speaker: Cactus Expert

Temple Ruin#013.src: Only the sharpest blades'll cut these cactus though. My collection's out back. You can look, but don't touch!
Temple Ruin#013.dst: Mas só as lâminas mais afiadas cortam esses cactos. Minha coleção tá lá nos fundos. Pode olhar, mas não toque!
Temple Ruin#013.speaker: Cactus Expert

The Final Moments#001.src: Crystalites. This is bad. Froner? FRONER? Are you there? We have a BIG problem.
The Final Moments#001.dst: Crystalites. Isso é grave. Froner? FRONER? Está aí? Temos um problema ENORME.
The Final Moments#001.speaker: Olm Mage

The Final Moments#002.src: What? More meteors hitting the mountains again? When has that ever been an issue before?
The Final Moments#002.dst: O quê? Mais meteoros caindo nas montanhas? Quando isso já foi problema?
The Final Moments#002.speaker: Olm Astrologist

The Final Moments#003.src: There's a series of fireballs heading towards the city.
The Final Moments#003.dst: Bolas de fogo estão vindo em direção à cidade.
The Final Moments#003.speaker: Olm Mage

The Final Moments#004.src: How long have we got left? We need to inform th-
The Final Moments#004.dst: Quanto tempo nos resta? Temos que avisar o-
The Final Moments#004.speaker: Olm Astrologist

The Forest has Eyes#001.src: Whenever one of the miners of {p} loses their soul, their eyes do not disappear...
The Forest has Eyes#001.dst: {c1}Sempre que um dos mineiros de {p} perde a alma, seus olhos não desaparecem...{/}

The Forest has Eyes#002.src: ...they merely become part of the forest.
The Forest has Eyes#002.dst: {c1}...apenas passam a fazer parte da floresta.{/}

The Great Sap Siphon#001.src: You can hear mechanical noises from the inside, but the door seems to be shut tight.
The Great Sap Siphon#001.dst: Dá para ouvir ruídos mecânicos lá dentro, mas a porta parece bem trancada.

The Great Sap Siphon#002.src: This pipe seems dried up, but the hardened sap is blocking it. Perhaps there is something nearby to remove it?
The Great Sap Siphon#002.dst: Este cano parece seco, mas a seiva endurecida o está entupindo. Talvez haja algo por perto para removê-la?

The Great Sap Siphon#003.src: As you take a closer look, you notice that the note seems to be very hastily written.
The Great Sap Siphon#003.dst: Olhando mais de perto, você nota que o bilhete parece escrito às pressas.

The Great Sap Siphon#004.src: "WARNING: Do NOT, under any circumstances, fill the tubes with sap doses of nine, six, and three respectively."
The Great Sap Siphon#004.dst: "AVISO: NÃO encha, em hipótese alguma, os tubos com doses de seiva de nove, seis e três, respectivamente."

The Great Sap Siphon#005.src: "Turns out there's a serious design flaw in the system... Something to do with pressure... Didn't catch all the details in Soosu's rant."
The Great Sap Siphon#005.dst: "Pelo visto há uma falha grave de projeto no sistema... Algo a ver com pressão... Não peguei todos os detalhes do sermão da Soosu."

The Great Sap Siphon#006.src: "Anyway, the thing can explode, so if you somehow manage to mess this up, evacuate the facility immediately."
The Great Sap Siphon#006.dst: "Enfim, a coisa pode explodir, então se de algum jeito fizerem besteira, evacuem a instalação na hora."

The Great Sap Siphon#007.src: "Fortunately, it's not an easy state to get the machine into by accident. You'd have to be doing it deliberately, I would think. But please stay mindful anyway."
The Great Sap Siphon#007.dst: "Por sorte, não é fácil deixar a máquina nesse estado por acidente. Teria que ser de propósito, acho eu. Mas fiquem atentos mesmo assim."

The Great Sap Siphon#008.src: There's a piece of paper on the ground, seemingly torn from some kind of book. Would you like to read it?
The Great Sap Siphon#008.dst: Há um pedaço de papel no chão, aparentemente arrancado de algum livro. Quer lê-lo?

The Great Sap Siphon#009.src: Sovereign Soosu has, yet again, felt the need to delegate her work to us. How irritating.
The Great Sap Siphon#009.dst: A Soberana Soosu, mais uma vez, resolveu delegar o trabalho dela a nós. Que irritante.

The Great Sap Siphon#010.src: One can only imagine what ridiculous project she feels is more important to work on than this. Anything is possible after the Pancake Trebuchet.
The Great Sap Siphon#010.dst: Só dá para imaginar que projeto ridículo ela acha mais importante que este. Depois do Trabuco de Panquecas, tudo é possível.

The Great Sap Siphon#011.src: As always, it was too difficult to say no, though (on top of being probably illegal), so I had to accept.
The Great Sap Siphon#011.dst: Como sempre, era difícil demais dizer não (além de provavelmente ilegal), então tive que aceitar.

The Great Sap Siphon#012.src: Apparently, the Queen is looking for new sources of food for the populace. In particular, sugar. No surprise, I'm sure Soosu embezzles half of the supply.
The Great Sap Siphon#012.dst: Pelo visto, a Rainha busca novas fontes de alimento para a população. Em especial, açúcar. Nada surpreendente, aposto que Soosu desvia metade do estoque.

The Great Sap Siphon#013.src: Soosu said the conversation gave her an idea - a tree genetically engineered to have sap rich in sugar, which can be harvested and refined.
The Great Sap Siphon#013.dst: Soosu disse que a conversa lhe deu uma ideia - uma árvore geneticamente modificada com seiva rica em açúcar, para ser colhida e refinada.

The Great Sap Siphon#014.src: Unfortunately, this means we're going to be breeding trees for a while. I have gathered some Maple saplings to begin with, seeing as they are already used for similar purposes.
The Great Sap Siphon#014.dst: Infelizmente, isso significa que vamos cruzar árvores por um tempo. Reuni algumas mudas de bordo para começar, já que já são usadas para fins parecidos.

The Great Sap Siphon#015.src: I hate this job. I really do. I wish I knew what "Biology Assistant" actually entailed before I applied.
The Great Sap Siphon#015.dst: Odeio este emprego. Odeio mesmo. Queria saber o que era ser "Assistente de Biologia" antes de entrar.

The Great Sap Siphon#016.src: All five years of our work are out the window now, because Soosu's thought of a better idea, and the previous trees we were breeding aren't compatible.
The Great Sap Siphon#016.dst: Todos os cinco anos de trabalho foram por água abaixo, porque Soosu pensou numa ideia melhor, e as árvores que cruzávamos não são compatíveis.

The Great Sap Siphon#017.src: Her new idea? Honestly, it is pretty interesting. A tree whose sap can be used for a multitude of things...
The Great Sap Siphon#017.dst: A nova ideia dela? Sinceramente, é bem interessante. Uma árvore cuja seiva serve para uma porção de coisas...

The Great Sap Siphon#018.src: Sugar, like before, is one use. But now she thinks we could make a sap that can be used as biofuel, as well as a strange new material she's calling "Rubber."
The Great Sap Siphon#018.dst: Açúcar, como antes, é um uso. Mas agora ela acha que dá pra fazer uma seiva usável como biocombustível, e um material novo e estranho que ela chama de "Borracha".

The Great Sap Siphon#019.src: I am very frustrated about her lack of regard for our previous iterations. But I must admit. This project could be exciting to work on.
The Great Sap Siphon#019.dst: Estou muito frustrado com o descaso dela pelas versões anteriores. Mas admito. Este projeto pode ser empolgante.

The Great Sap Siphon#020.src: This time, we will be using the Roughworks' very own trees - their sap seems like it would be suitable for this.
The Great Sap Siphon#020.dst: Desta vez, usaremos as próprias árvores de Roughworks - a seiva delas parece adequada para isso.

The Great Sap Siphon#021.src: It's been years and years of headache. A nightmare tuning the tree genes to be just right. But at last, the project is getting somewhere.
The Great Sap Siphon#021.dst: Foram anos e anos de dor de cabeça. Um pesadelo ajustar os genes das árvores no ponto certo. Mas enfim, o projeto está avançando.

The Great Sap Siphon#023.src: In fact, it's getting so promising, that Soosu's now planning out some kind of major sap collection system. She calls it "The Great Sap Siphon."
The Great Sap Siphon#023.dst: Aliás, está tão promissor que Soosu agora planeja um grande sistema de coleta de seiva. Ela o chama de "O Grande Sifão de Seiva".

The Great Sap Siphon#024.src: The plan is to set up automated collection machines on each tree, hooked up to a network of pipes, which transport the sap to factories that can refine it into usable resources. Sounds expensive.
The Great Sap Siphon#024.dst: O plano é instalar coletores automáticos em cada árvore, ligados a uma rede de canos que leva a seiva a fábricas que a refinam em recursos úteis. Parece caro.

The Great Sap Siphon#025.src: It'll probably still be a few more years of breeding the trees, but soon enough, I won't have to think about this anymore..!
The Great Sap Siphon#025.dst: Provavelmente ainda serão mais alguns anos cruzando árvores, mas logo, logo, não vou mais ter que pensar nisso..!

The Great Sap Siphon#026.src: Finally, after {~} years of work, we have done it. The perfect tree has been born.
The Great Sap Siphon#026.dst: Enfim, após {~} anos de trabalho, conseguimos. Nasceu a árvore perfeita.

The Great Sap Siphon#027.src: Sap that can be used for all kinds of things. An invention that will surely make my name worthy of a spot in the history books! Oh, and everyone else on the team, too.
The Great Sap Siphon#027.dst: Seiva que serve para todo tipo de coisa. Uma invenção que com certeza fará meu nome digno de um lugar nos livros de história! Ah, e o resto da equipe também.

The Great Sap Siphon#028.src: Soosu has insisted on calling the new tree variety "Industrees." We all hate the name, but there's no reasoning with her.
The Great Sap Siphon#028.dst: Soosu insistiu em chamar a nova variedade de "Industrees". Todos odiamos o nome, mas não há como argumentar com ela.

The Great Sap Siphon#029.src: Now all that needs to be done is infrastructure construction, and the sap siphon project will be complete!
The Great Sap Siphon#029.dst: Agora só falta construir a infraestrutura, e o projeto do sifão de seiva estará concluído!

The Great Sap Siphon#030.src: Since we're draining all the sap from the Industrees, it's necessary to keep one "mother" tree somewhere, otherwise we won't be able to source any viable saplings.
The Great Sap Siphon#030.dst: Como vamos drenar toda a seiva das Industrees, é preciso manter uma árvore "mãe" em algum lugar, senão não teremos mudas viáveis.

The Great Sap Siphon#031.src: I was advised to keep it in a private area, to eliminate the risk of it being destroyed by enemies of the state. A good idea.
The Great Sap Siphon#031.dst: Me aconselharam a mantê-la numa área privada, para eliminar o risco de ser destruída por inimigos do Estado. Boa ideia.

The Great Sap Siphon#032.src: Thus, this breeding facility shall now be converted into a hydroponic nursery for growing new Industrees out of the public eye.
The Great Sap Siphon#032.dst: Assim, esta instalação de cruzamento vira agora um viveiro hidropônico para cultivar novas Industrees longe dos olhos do público.

The Great Sap Siphon#033.src: And with that, this project is complete! ...At this point, I should probably think about retiring.
The Great Sap Siphon#033.dst: E com isso, o projeto está concluído! ...A esta altura, eu devia pensar em me aposentar.

The Great Sap Siphon#034.src: I will leave this logbook here, so that future attendants to this facility can read up on the journey that was the development of the Industree. This painful experience cannot be forgotten.
The Great Sap Siphon#034.dst: Deixo este diário aqui, para que os futuros responsáveis pela instalação leiam a jornada que foi criar a Industree. Essa experiência dolorosa não pode ser esquecida.

The Great Sap Siphon#035.src: Considering the state you found the logbook in, it doesn't seem like anybody really cared as much as this person hoped.
The Great Sap Siphon#035.dst: Pelo estado em que você achou o diário, parece que ninguém ligou tanto quanto essa pessoa esperava.

The Legend of Bob#000.src: The Legend of Bob - Chapter I: {~} years after the portal was first opened, {p} suffered one of the largest raids ever recorded on western soil.
The Legend of Bob#000.dst: {c1}A Lenda de Bob - Capítulo I: {c2}{~} anos depois que o portal foi aberto, {p} sofreu um dos maiores ataques já registrados em solo ocidental.{/}

The Legend of Bob#001.src: Although the famous forts of {p} and {p} were deemed impenetrable, this was unfortunately not the case when seas of monsters brought by the curse came knocking on the front gate.
The Legend of Bob#001.dst: {c1}Embora os famosos fortes de {p} e {p} fossem tidos como impenetráveis, infelizmente não foi o caso quando mares de monstros trazidos pela maldição bateram no portão principal.{/}

The Legend of Bob#002.src: Despite having fought for centuries in the cursed war, {p}'s army numbers were high and many a men laid down their lives to protect the families within the walls.
The Legend of Bob#002.dst: {c1}Apesar de lutar havia séculos na guerra amaldiçoada, o exército de {p} era numeroso, e muitos homens deram a vida para proteger as famílias dentro das muralhas.{/}

The Legend of Bob#003.src: However, the sheer numbers pressed against the door broke the hinges and the large gate fell into the bridge, and the largest horde recorded entered the city.
The Legend of Bob#003.dst: {c1}Porém, a enorme massa empurrando a porta quebrou as dobradiças, o grande portão caiu sobre a ponte e a maior horda já registrada entrou na cidade.{/}

The Legend of Bob#004.src: Many of the residents were slaughtered, maimed or infected by the onslaught of creatures.
The Legend of Bob#004.dst: {c1}Muitos moradores foram massacrados, mutilados ou infectados pela investida das criaturas.

The Legend of Bob#005.src: The Legend of Bob - Chapter II: The idea was to combine two of the most horrible things, the untreated sewage, and the dark cells containing Wynn's worst criminals, to add to their suffering.
The Legend of Bob#005.dst: {c1}A Lenda de Bob - Capítulo II: {c2}A ideia era juntar duas das coisas mais horríveis, o esgoto não tratado e as celas escuras com os piores criminosos de Wynn, para aumentar seu sofrimento.{/}

The Legend of Bob#006.src: It really was a horrid place, but in a time like this, it was the safest place to be, and the women and children sought refuge in its stench.
The Legend of Bob#006.dst: {c1}Era mesmo um lugar horrível, mas numa época dessas era o lugar mais seguro, e mulheres e crianças buscaram refúgio em seu fedor.{/}

The Legend of Bob#007.src: During the fight, a woman who never said her name, nor where she had come from (she certainly wasn't one of {p}'s own) gave birth to a baby boy on the cold floors of the sewer.
The Legend of Bob#007.dst: {c1}Durante a luta, uma mulher que nunca disse o nome nem de onde vinha (com certeza não era de {p}) deu à luz um menino no chão frio do esgoto.{/}

The Legend of Bob#008.src: Though the women accompanying her did all they could, the unknown woman did not survive the childbirth.
The Legend of Bob#008.dst: {c1}Embora as mulheres que a acompanhavam fizessem tudo o que podiam, a desconhecida não sobreviveu ao parto.{/}

The Legend of Bob#009.src: The horde lasted {~} days and the sewer folk did not know if the baby would make it, the conditions were so rotten.
The Legend of Bob#009.dst: {c1}A horda durou {~} dias e o povo do esgoto não sabia se o bebê sobreviveria, de tão podres que eram as condições.{/}

The Legend of Bob#010.src: The Legend of Bob - Chapter III: Against all the odds, the child made it.
The Legend of Bob#010.dst: {c1}A Lenda de Bob - Capítulo III: {c2}Contra tudo, a criança sobreviveu.{/}

The Legend of Bob#011.src: He worked in a local bakery carrying bread and cake into the palace, taking whatever he could get away with.
The Legend of Bob#011.dst: {c1}Ele trabalhava numa padaria levando pães e bolos ao palácio, pegando tudo o que conseguia sem ser pego.{/}

The Legend of Bob#012.src: Despite his mother being poor, she was none the less intelligent, and taught the child, who she named Robert, everything she knew, taught him to read, write and to a degree, to fight.
The Legend of Bob#012.dst: {c1}Embora pobre, a mãe dele era muito inteligente, e ensinou ao menino, que chamou de Robert, tudo o que sabia: a ler, a escrever e, até certo ponto, a lutar.{/}

The Legend of Bob#013.src: Robert was never a popular lad, always treated differently, his skin was a shade of grey unnatural to those of {p}, who have always been fair skinned.
The Legend of Bob#013.dst: {c1}Robert nunca foi um rapaz popular, sempre tratado diferente; sua pele tinha um tom de cinza estranho ao povo de {p}, que sempre teve pele clara.{/}

The Legend of Bob#014.src: As such he didn't have many friends and wasn't held particularly well among the older citizens either.
The Legend of Bob#014.dst: {c1}Por isso, não tinha muitos amigos e também não era bem visto pelos cidadãos mais velhos.{/}

The Legend of Bob#015.src: When he was {~} years old, a horde found its way into the city once more, like it did just over a decade before.
The Legend of Bob#015.dst: {c1}Quando ele tinha {~} anos, uma horda entrou na cidade mais uma vez, como pouco mais de uma década antes.{/}

The Legend of Bob#016.src: The Legend of Bob - Chapter IV: Although far smaller than its predecessor, the horde was none the less a threat as {p}'s army was so wounded from the last encounter.
The Legend of Bob#016.dst: {c1}A Lenda de Bob - Capítulo IV: {c2}Embora bem menor que a anterior, a horda ainda era uma ameaça, pois o exército de {p} seguia muito ferido do último confronto.{/}

The Legend of Bob#017.src: The beacons were not lit from the scouts, and caught the entire city by surprise. Not Robert though, he always keeps a knife he stole from the butchers in his belt to protect the ones he loves.
The Legend of Bob#017.dst: {c1}Os batedores não acenderam os sinais, e a cidade inteira foi pega de surpresa. Mas não Robert: ele sempre levava no cinto uma faca roubada dos açougueiros para proteger quem amava.{/}

The Legend of Bob#018.src: Being so poor, Momos shack was on the outskirts of {p} and was one of the first to get hit, Robert ran for the house, finding it empty, but hearing a gasping from below.
The Legend of Bob#018.dst: {c1}Por serem tão pobres, o barraco de Momo ficava nos arredores de {p} e foi dos primeiros atingidos. Robert correu para casa e a achou vazia, mas ouviu um arquejo embaixo.{/}

The Legend of Bob#019.src: Entering the cellar, he found his mother lying bleeding beside a recently stabbed creature. He went to her aid, knowing it would be in vain.
The Legend of Bob#019.dst: {c1}Ao entrar no porão, achou a mãe sangrando ao lado de uma criatura recém-esfaqueada. Foi socorrê-la, sabendo que seria em vão.{/}

The Legend of Bob#020.src: She simply nodded at him, they had made an agreement when Robert was {~} years old that if she ever became infected she wanted him to end her life, rather than endure the gruesome prolonged infection that had no cure.
The Legend of Bob#020.dst: {c1}Ela só assentiu. Quando Robert tinha {~} anos, tinham combinado que, se ela fosse infectada, ele acabaria com a vida dela, para que não sofresse a longa e horrível infecção sem cura.{/}

The Legend of Bob#021.src: The Legend of Bob - Chapter V: Momo placed in Robert's hands a piece of parchment with a crude blood stained drawing of {~} areas each with a strange name under it he hadn't heard of.
The Legend of Bob#021.dst: {c1}A Lenda de Bob - Capítulo V: {c2}Momo pôs nas mãos de Robert um pergaminho com um desenho tosco manchado de sangue de {~} áreas, cada uma com um nome estranho embaixo que ele nunca ouvira.{/}

The Legend of Bob#022.src: In the fires of the fight, Robert fled from the city, wielding not his butcher's knife, but a pair of pitch black knives encrusted with symbols that glowed a purple colour, a cloak and a pouch holding what little food was left in the house.
The Legend of Bob#022.dst: {c1}No fogo da batalha, Robert fugiu da cidade empunhando não sua faca de açougueiro, mas um par de facas negras como breu, cravejadas de símbolos que brilhavam em roxo, uma capa e uma bolsa com a pouca comida que restava em casa.{/}

The Legend of Bob#023.src: He headed east, to the sandy area indicated by his mother's drawing, the one with the knife symbol, and the number "{~}".
The Legend of Bob#023.dst: {c1}Ele seguiu para o leste, à área arenosa indicada no desenho da mãe, a do símbolo da faca e do número "{~}".{/}

The Legend of Bob#024.src: When Robert reached it, he found one man, who did nothing but held out his hand, and Robert placed the only thing of value to him, the dark daggers in his hand.
The Legend of Bob#024.dst: {c1}Ao chegar, Robert encontrou um único homem, que nada fez além de estender a mão, e Robert pôs nela a única coisa de valor que tinha, as adagas escuras.{/}

The Legend of Bob#025.src: The man began to tell Robert of what he must now do to aid in the war; he must travel to the {~} masters of Wynn province, to learn their magic and skill if he is to lend his hand in the cursed war.
The Legend of Bob#025.dst: {c1}O homem contou a Robert o que ele devia fazer para ajudar na guerra: viajar até os {~} mestres da província de Wynn e aprender sua magia e habilidade, se quisesse ajudar na guerra amaldiçoada.{/}

The Legend of Bob#026.src: Only once he had mastered one skill would he be given the key that the next master would accept.
The Legend of Bob#026.dst: {c1}Só depois de dominar uma arte ele receberia a chave que o próximo mestre aceitaria.{/}

The Legend of Bob#027.src: The Legend of Bob - Chapter VI: After {~} years of training to become an assassin, Robert was now {~} years old and incredibly powerful.
The Legend of Bob#027.dst: {c1}A Lenda de Bob - Capítulo VI: {c2}Após {~} anos de treino para se tornar assassino, Robert já tinha {~} anos e um poder incrível.{/}

The Legend of Bob#028.src: Chak took Robert's daggers, to which the handles began to glow bright and moulded together to form a large sheen bow, to which he strung a thick strand of his own hair.
The Legend of Bob#028.dst: {c1}Chak pegou as adagas de Robert; os cabos começaram a brilhar e se fundiram num grande arco reluzente, que ele encordoou com uma grossa mecha do próprio cabelo.{/}

The Legend of Bob#029.src: Chak handed it back to him, and said "even the most experienced soldier must start from scratch when learning a new mastery".
The Legend of Bob#029.dst: {c1}Chak o devolveu e disse: "até o soldado mais experiente deve começar do zero ao aprender uma nova arte".{/}

The Legend of Bob#030.src: Robert began his journey further south; past the blizzards into a pocket of land he'd never seen on any map the bow symbol with the number "{~}" accompanying it.
The Legend of Bob#030.dst: {c1}Robert seguiu viagem mais ao sul; além das nevascas, até um pedaço de terra que nunca vira em mapa algum, o do símbolo do arco com o número "{~}".{/}

The Legend of Bob#031.src: It was home to only one building, a large mansion, to which a man stood with his hands outstretched as Robert approached.
The Legend of Bob#031.dst: {c1}Ali havia só uma grande mansão, diante da qual um homem esperava de mãos estendidas quando Robert se aproximou.{/}

The Legend of Bob#032.src: Just like {~} years previous, Robert handed him the bow, to which he said "I am Mael, master of archery, let us begin. Just as you progress, as does the war."
The Legend of Bob#032.dst: {c1}Assim como {~} anos antes, Robert lhe entregou o arco, e ele disse: "Sou Mael, mestre do arco e flecha, vamos começar. Assim como você avança, avança a guerra."{/}

The Legend of Bob#033.src: To which Robert spent a further {~} years mastering the art of crafting and firing arrows, in any situation and learning the magic surrounding the bow.
The Legend of Bob#033.dst: {c1}E Robert passou mais {~} anos dominando a arte de fazer e disparar flechas em qualquer situação, e aprendendo a magia que envolve o arco.{/}

The Legend of Bob#034.src: The Legend of Bob - Chapter VII: In this time, Robert also learnt about the areas he trained in.
The Legend of Bob#034.dst: {c1}A Lenda de Bob - Capítulo VII: {c2}Nesse tempo, Robert também aprendeu sobre as áreas onde treinou.

The Legend of Bob#035.src: Robert learnt about the other side and how many of the fallen soldiers return cursed to fight on the other side, to which Robert secretly hoped he was able to communicate with his deceased mother.
The Legend of Bob#035.dst: {c1}Robert aprendeu sobre o outro lado e como muitos soldados caídos voltam amaldiçoados para lutar pelo outro lado, e em segredo desejou poder falar com a mãe falecida.

The Legend of Bob#036.src: However, Robert never expressed these desires, and Mael told him the time had come to learn some magic that involved no physical weapon that you could hit people with.
The Legend of Bob#036.dst: {c1}Porém, Robert nunca expressou esses desejos, e Mael lhe disse que era hora de aprender uma magia sem nenhuma arma física com que bater nas pessoas.

The Legend of Bob#037.src: Robert handed over his bow, to which a familiar glow transformed it into a pure black rod, with the same purple markings around them.
The Legend of Bob#037.dst: {c1}Robert entregou o arco, e um brilho familiar o transformou numa vara negra pura, com as mesmas marcas roxas em volta.

The Legend of Bob#038.src: Robert looked at the old, frayed map, to see the next area with a single line in it, and the number "{~}", except this time, he knew what area that was.
The Legend of Bob#038.dst: {c1}Robert olhou o velho mapa puído e viu a próxima área, com uma única linha e o número "{~}", só que desta vez sabia que lugar era.

The Legend of Bob#039.src: It was the forest he passed through when he was {~} years old to get to the desert to begin his training, he barely made it. For the first time since he began his training, Robert was filled with fear.
The Legend of Bob#039.dst: {c1}Era a floresta que atravessou aos {~} anos para chegar ao deserto e começar o treino; mal conseguiu. Pela primeira vez desde o início do treino, Robert sentiu medo.

The Legend of Bob#040.src: The Legend of Bob - Chapter VIII: The forest was full of spiders and poison, and the thought of poison always reminded him of the time he...
The Legend of Bob#040.dst: {c1}A Lenda de Bob - Capítulo VIII: {c2}A floresta era cheia de aranhas e veneno, e pensar em veneno sempre o lembrava da vez em que...{/}

The Legend of Bob#041.src: He couldn't for the life of him make it work.
The Legend of Bob#041.dst: {c1}Por mais que tentasse, não dava certo.

The Legend of Bob#042.src: "You are half way through your journey, do not let frustration warp you, let us begin the hardest of all arts." were the first words, Ethe, the magical master had ever said to him.
The Legend of Bob#042.dst: {c1}"Você está na metade da jornada, não deixe a frustração te distorcer, vamos começar a mais difícil das artes." foram as primeiras palavras que Ethe, mestre da magia, lhe disse.{/}

The Legend of Bob#043.src: And it was certainly true, wand lore had not come so easily to him as knavery or archery had.
The Legend of Bob#043.dst: {c1}E era mesmo verdade: a arte da varinha não lhe vinha tão fácil quanto a malandragem ou o arco.{/}

The Legend of Bob#044.src: However the arts of magic eventually flowed through him over the coming {~} years, to which point Robert was now {~} years old, and beginning to wonder if he would ever remain young enough to fight in the war.
The Legend of Bob#044.dst: {c1}Mesmo assim, as artes mágicas enfim fluíram por ele nos {~} anos seguintes; a essa altura Robert tinha {~} anos e começava a se perguntar se ainda seria jovem para lutar na guerra.{/}

The Legend of Bob#045.src: Ethe told Robert it was time to move on, and transformed his wand into its final form...
The Legend of Bob#045.dst: {c1}Ethe disse a Robert que era hora de seguir, e deu à varinha sua forma final...{/}

The Legend of Bob#046.src: The Legend of Bob - Chapter IX: The map indicated that he must travel to {p}, where the last spear symbol and the number "{~}" were written. Upon arrival, Robert was surprised; the city had been hit — hard.
The Legend of Bob#046.dst: {c1}A Lenda de Bob - Capítulo IX: {c2}O mapa indicava que ele devia ir a {p}, onde estavam escritos o último símbolo, a lança, e o número "{~}". Ao chegar, Robert se surpreendeu; a cidade fora atingida — e com força.{/}

The Legend of Bob#047.src: He'd never heard of {p} so much as receiving a scratch from the creatures, it was so well guarded, but then again, Robert had been absent from civilization for {~} years.
The Legend of Bob#047.dst: {c1}Ele nunca ouvira falar de {p} sofrer sequer um arranhão das criaturas, de tão bem guardada, mas também, Robert estivera longe da civilização por {~} anos.{/}

The Legend of Bob#048.src: In the fires, a man stood with his hand out stretched, completely ignoring the pleads of the people around him begging for help, to which Robert placed his spear.
The Legend of Bob#048.dst: {c1}Entre as chamas, um homem esperava de mão estendida, ignorando por completo os apelos das pessoas ao redor implorando ajuda, e Robert pôs nela sua lança.{/}

The Legend of Bob#049.src: The man said "This is the final leg of your journey, let the plights of this town that you see here today force you onward with your training, and help protect this land when you are done.
The Legend of Bob#049.dst: {c1}O homem disse: "Esta é a última etapa da sua jornada. Que as aflições desta cidade que você vê hoje o impulsionem no treino, e ajude a proteger esta terra quando terminar.{/}

The Legend of Bob#050.src: Robert spent the next {~} years learning the skills surrounding the spear in the great city of {p}, rebuilding and defending it when necessary in his spare time.
The Legend of Bob#050.dst: {c1}Robert passou os {~} anos seguintes aprendendo as artes da lança na grande cidade de {p}, reconstruindo-a e defendendo-a quando preciso nas horas vagas.{/}

The Legend of Bob#051.src: It was the first time he was with people, and by people, I mean people that aren't strict masters of their art that seem to solely exist to teach Robert the ways of the soldier.
The Legend of Bob#051.dst: {c1}Era a primeira vez que estava com pessoas, e por pessoas quero dizer gente que não é mestre rigoroso de sua arte e parece existir só para ensinar a Robert os caminhos do soldado.{/}

The Legend of Bob#052.src: The Legend of Bob - Chapter X: Robert learnt to love the people he was around, and people called him Bob, rather than Robert, a girl told him "I don't know, I think you just sound better when you're called Bob."
The Legend of Bob#052.dst: {c1}A Lenda de Bob - Capítulo X: {c2}Robert aprendeu a amar as pessoas ao seu redor, e elas o chamavam de Bob em vez de Robert. Uma garota lhe disse: "Sei lá, acho que você soa melhor quando te chamam de Bob."{/}

The Legend of Bob#053.src: Robert liked it, and when he met new people, he introduced himself as thus.
The Legend of Bob#053.dst: {c1}Robert gostou, e ao conhecer gente nova, se apresentava assim.{/}

The Legend of Bob#054.src: Fier's training after {~} long years had finally come to an end, to which he said this: "You are now the strongest soldier this province has ever seen, use your power wisely, and you shall end this war."
The Legend of Bob#054.dst: {c1}O treino de Fier, após {~} longos anos, enfim chegou ao fim, e ele disse: "Agora você é o soldado mais forte que esta província já viu. Use seu poder com sabedoria e você acabará com esta guerra."{/}

The Legend of Bob#055.src: Then, to his surprise, all the masters materialised in a line beside Fier, and smiled, Mael even nodding slowly at him, to which a voice behind him said "Why are you crying Bob? There's no one there..."
The Legend of Bob#055.dst: {c1}Então, para sua surpresa, todos os mestres surgiram em fila ao lado de Fier e sorriram, Mael até assentindo devagar, e uma voz atrás dele disse: "Por que está chorando, Bob? Não tem ninguém aí..."{/}

The Legend of Bob#056.src: The {~} masters vanished and Bob knew what he must now do, return to {p} to save what little is left of it.
The Legend of Bob#056.dst: {c1}Os {~} mestres sumiram e Bob soube o que devia fazer: voltar a {p} para salvar o pouco que restava dela.{/}

The Legend of Bob#057.src: The Legend of Bob - Chapter XI: Bob then spent the remainder of his life serving as Wynns private demigod, destroying all creatures that ever came near a settlement under his protection.
The Legend of Bob#057.dst: {c1}A Lenda de Bob - Capítulo XI: {c2}Bob passou o resto da vida servindo como semideus particular de Wynn, destruindo toda criatura que se aproximasse de um povoado sob sua proteção.{/}

The Legend of Bob#058.src: He did not pass on his skills, in fear they would not be used for the greater good, which troubled him. For if he were to pass, who would replace him?
The Legend of Bob#058.dst: {c1}Ele não transmitiu suas habilidades, com medo de que não fossem usadas para o bem maior, o que o preocupava. Pois, se ele morresse, quem o substituiria?{/}

The Legend of Bob#059.src: Certainly not his {~} companions, the animals which he loved dearly, perhaps he would brew them a potion, prolonging their life; they were good animals after all.
The Legend of Bob#059.dst: {c1}Certamente não seus {~} companheiros, os animais que tanto amava; talvez lhes preparasse uma poção para prolongar sua vida; afinal, eram bons animais.{/}

The Legend of Bob#060.src: Bob's story quickly became a huge beacon of hope for many fighting the war; no one could defeat Bob and his dark weapons.
The Legend of Bob#060.dst: {c1}A história de Bob logo virou um enorme farol de esperança para muitos na guerra; ninguém vencia Bob e suas armas sombrias.{/}

The Legend of Bob#061.src: However, this is where the story becomes myth, I'm afraid. After over a century of fighting, Bob vanished in the year {~} AP (After Portal).
The Legend of Bob#061.dst: {c1}Porém, receio que aqui a história vire mito. Após mais de um século de luta, Bob desapareceu no ano {~} AP (Após o Portal).{/}

The Legend of Bob#062.src: The Legend of Bob - Chapter XII: It was rumoured he heard of a beast corrupting the province, promoting the war and increasing the strength of the monsters.
The Legend of Bob#062.dst: {c1}A Lenda de Bob - Capítulo XII: {c2}Dizia-se que ele soube de uma fera que corrompia a província, alimentando a guerra e fortalecendo os monstros.{/}

The Legend of Bob#063.src: I imagine Bob probably sought to destroy it, but in his old age, perhaps he wasn't up to the mark.
The Legend of Bob#063.dst: {c1}Imagino que Bob tenha tentado destruí-la, mas, na velhice, talvez já não estivesse à altura.{/}

The Legend of Bob#064.src: It was then, though, just one year after his disappearance, Bobs tomb appeared in the snow, marking the place where he was buried.
The Legend of Bob#064.dst: {c1}Foi então, porém, só um ano após seu sumiço, que o túmulo de Bob apareceu na neve, marcando o lugar onde foi enterrado.{/}

The Legend of Bob#065.src: By whom? No one knows. Perhaps it was the killer? Or maybe it was his master's magic? It still lies there today, holding his body, it is worth a visit, many have told of great adventures and magic surrounding the place.
The Legend of Bob#065.dst: {c1}Por quem? Ninguém sabe. Talvez o assassino? Ou a magia de seus mestres? Ainda está lá hoje, guardando seu corpo; vale a visita, muitos contam grandes aventuras e magia em torno do lugar.{/}

The Legend of Bob#066.src: One thing is for sure, Bob truly was the master of the Wynn arts, and will forever go down in our history as the mightiest soldier.
The Legend of Bob#066.dst: {c1}Uma coisa é certa: Bob foi mesmo o mestre das artes de Wynn, e entrará para sempre em nossa história como o soldado mais poderoso.{/}

The Legend of Bob#067.src: Perhaps one day, someone will follow in his footsteps.
The Legend of Bob#067.dst: {c1}Talvez um dia alguém siga seus passos.{/}

The Legend of Bob#068.src: Those able to run hid in the sewers, a vast series of tunnels that run out of the city, and into the foulest place the humans could create, their prison.
The Legend of Bob#068.dst: {c1}Quem pôde correr se escondeu no esgoto, uma vasta rede de túneis que saem da cidade rumo ao lugar mais imundo que os humanos poderiam criar, sua prisão.{/}

The Legend of Bob#069.src: Suffering no more but a smudge of dirt across his cheek, to everyone's amazement, he was adopted by {p}'s poorest resident, a single mother named Momo.
The Legend of Bob#069.dst: {c1}Sem nada além de uma mancha de terra na bochecha, para espanto de todos, ele foi adotado pela moradora mais pobre de {p}, uma mãe solteira chamada Momo.{/}

The Legend of Bob#070.src: The master, Chak, who had taught him, told him his time was now up with him and he would have to progress to learn Archer.
The Legend of Bob#070.dst: {c1}O mestre que o ensinara, Chak, disse que seu tempo com ele acabara e que agora ele devia aprender a arte do Arqueiro.{/}

The Legend of Bob#071.src: And it was true, Robert was not equipped to deal with any creature that faced him, he'd never even fired a bow!
The Legend of Bob#071.dst: {c1}E era verdade: Robert não estava pronto para criatura alguma que o enfrentasse, nunca tinha nem disparado um arco!{/}

The Legend of Bob#072.src: Mael was incredibly spiritual; the mansion in which he lived in was also house to many spirits which found Mael to heal them.
The Legend of Bob#072.dst: {c1}Mael era muito espiritual; a mansão onde vivia também abrigava muitos espíritos que o procuravam para se curar.

The Legend of Bob#073.src: Well, never mind that. Robert set off to the forest wielding a stick that was about as much use as a hollowed out pumpkin.
The Legend of Bob#073.dst: {c1}Bem, deixa pra lá. Robert partiu para a floresta empunhando um graveto tão útil quanto uma abóbora oca.

The Legend of Bob#074.src: Regardless, when he reached the forest, he entered a mystical village suspended in the trees lit by hanging lamps, to which the familiar sight of a man with his hand outstretched grasped the wand Robert laid in his hand.
The Legend of Bob#074.dst: {c1}Mesmo assim, ao chegar à floresta, entrou numa aldeia mística suspensa nas árvores e iluminada por lampiões pendurados, onde a figura familiar de um homem de mão estendida pegou a varinha que Robert lhe deu.

The Legend of Bob#075.src: A giant black spear, even his mature eyes gleamed at the sight of it, the spear was the weapon of {p}, the greatest fort man had ever created.
The Legend of Bob#075.dst: {c1}Uma lança negra gigante; até seus olhos maduros brilharam ao vê-la. A lança era a arma de {p}, o maior forte que o homem já criou.{/}

The Legend of Bob#076.src: My name is Fier, Let us end your training."
The Legend of Bob#076.dst: {c1}Meu nome é Fier. Vamos terminar seu treino."{/}

The Royal University's Library#001.src: There's a note on the wagon...

The Royal University's Library#002.src: On the note, there's a {~}x{~} grid with some numbers. It seems to represent the flowerbed somehow.
The Royal University's Library#002.dst: No bilhete há uma grade {~}x{~} com alguns números. Parece representar o canteiro de algum jeito.

The Royal University's Library#003.src: Would you like to try making heads or tails of this?

The Royal University's Library#004.src: The groundskeeper just stormed off in a huff... He seemed stressed about something.
The Royal University's Library#004.dst: O jardineiro saiu bufando... Parecia estressado com algo.
The Royal University's Library#004.speaker: University Student

The Royal University's Library#005.src: I guess I would be too if I had to make a flower display for the Queen's visit, but he has a design to go off of, so it couldn't be too hard, right?
The Royal University's Library#005.dst: Eu também estaria, se tivesse que fazer um arranjo floral para a visita da Rainha, mas ele tem um projeto a seguir, então não deve ser tão difícil, né?
The Royal University's Library#005.speaker: University Student

The Royal University's Library#006.src: Oh... right... The chancellor had that one puzzle-obsessed girl make the garden plan... Now it all makes sense...
The Royal University's Library#006.dst: Ah... claro... A reitoria pediu o plano do jardim àquela garota obcecada por enigmas... Agora tudo faz sentido...
The Royal University's Library#006.speaker: University Student

The Royal University's Library#008.src: No pass, no entry. Buzz off.
The Royal University's Library#008.speaker: University Guard

The Royal University's Library#009.src: ...Wha? Surely ya couldn't be around 'ere without knowin' about this place...
The Royal University's Library#009.dst: ...Quê? Não me diga que cê anda por aqui sem saber deste lugar...
The Royal University's Library#009.speaker: University Guard

The Royal University's Library#010.src: This is The Royal University of Aelumia, the finest educational institution in the province. I'd be baffled if ya hadn't heard of it.
The Royal University's Library#010.dst: Esta é a {c2}Universidade Real de Aelumia{/}, a melhor instituição de ensino da província. Ficaria pasmo se cê nunca tivesse ouvido falar.
The Royal University's Library#010.speaker: University Guard

The Royal University's Library#011.src: Anyway. It's my duty to make sure the students 'ere are safe. And that job involves turnin' away people like you. Be gone.
The Royal University's Library#011.dst: Enfim. Meu dever é garantir que os alunos daqui estejam seguros. E isso inclui barrar gente como você. Vaza.
The Royal University's Library#011.speaker: University Guard

The Royal University's Library#012.src: Time to see how he's getting on...
The Royal University's Library#012.dst: Hora de ver como ele está indo...
The Royal University's Library#012.speaker: Chancellor

The Royal University's Library#014.src: It's perfect!! Thank you so much!! Wait...
The Royal University's Library#014.speaker: Chancellor

The Royal University's Library#015.src: You're not the groundskeeper... What's going on here?
The Royal University's Library#015.dst: Você não é o jardineiro... O que está acontecendo?
The Royal University's Library#015.speaker: Chancellor

The Royal University's Library#016.src: ...You planted the flowerbed yourself? Normally, I'd punish students for interfering in official business, but you did such a good job, you're off the hook!
The Royal University's Library#016.dst: ...Você mesmo plantou o canteiro? Normalmente eu puniria alunos por se meterem em assuntos oficiais, mas você fez um trabalho tão bom que está liberado!
The Royal University's Library#016.speaker: Chancellor

The Royal University's Library#017.src: You'd ought to go and take a rest after all that hard work! What about... the library?
The Royal University's Library#017.dst: Você devia ir descansar depois de tanto trabalho! Que tal... a {c2}biblioteca{/}?
The Royal University's Library#017.speaker: Chancellor

The Royal University's Library#018.src: ...You don't have a pass? Oh, silly you, you must've forgotten it. Here, let me write you a permission slip so you don't have to go searching for it right now.
The Royal University's Library#018.dst: ...Não tem passe? Ah, que cabeça a sua, deve ter esquecido. Tome, vou escrever uma autorização para você não precisar procurá-lo agora.
The Royal University's Library#018.speaker: Chancellor

The Royal University's Library#019.src: Uh, boss, I don't think they're a...
The Royal University's Library#019.dst: Hã, com licença, acho que não é um...
The Royal University's Library#019.speaker: Guard

The Royal University's Library#020.src: Shhh... Guards are to be seen and not heard.
The Royal University's Library#020.dst: Shhh... Guardas devem ser vistos, não ouvidos.
The Royal University's Library#020.speaker: Chancellor

The Royal University's Library#021.src: There. Here you go. Oh, and one more thing:
The Royal University's Library#021.dst: Pronto. Aqui está. Ah, e mais uma coisa:
The Royal University's Library#021.speaker: Chancellor

The Royal University's Library#022.src: Please wear a school uniform when Her Majesty comes around, alright?
The Royal University's Library#022.dst: Por favor, use o uniforme escolar quando Sua Majestade vier, está bem?
The Royal University's Library#022.speaker: Chancellor

The Royal University's Library#023.src: You can now access the University's library.
The Royal University's Library#023.dst: Agora você pode entrar na biblioteca.

The Royal University's Library#024.src: A signed permission slip from the Chancellor? Huh. Alright.
The Royal University's Library#024.dst: Uma autorização assinada pela reitoria? Hum. Tudo bem.
The Royal University's Library#024.speaker: University Guard

The Royal University's Library#025.src: Come with me. I have to escort you.
The Royal University's Library#025.dst: Venha comigo. Tenho que te escoltar.
The Royal University's Library#025.speaker: University Guard
